jobs.title: Internship in IT Onsite Support 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our collaborative OSS team and support daily IT operations close to the business. You ensure employees have reliable devices and a smooth digital workplace experience. In this hands‑on role, you learn how to troubleshoot technical issues and prepare essential IT equipment. You work closely with end users and gain valuable insights into how IT drives productivity. Throughout the 12 months internship, experienced colleagues support your growth and development. How   you'll   make an impact Assist   in troubleshooting basic IT issues, p repare laptops and other devices so they are ready for use by new or existing employees Support end users   in   navigating self ‑ service tools and standard IT procedures Assist with stock handling, asset pickup\/return, and device preparation for onboarding\/offboarding Support warranty processes by gathering information and preparing devices Help   maintain   IT equipment in meeting rooms and shared office spaces, ensuring systems   operate   correctly Update documentation related to device preparation and OSS procedures and report issues to the team.   Be   engaged in special projects where you   make impact ( relocating , changing office set-up,   set   up infrastructure,   set-up   of the meeting rooms)   Be engaged in special   on ‑ site   projects, such as office relocations,   changes   to office layouts, infrastructure setup, and preparation or reconfiguration of meeting rooms, contributing directly to how the workplace functions   Your background Currently studying at a university or technical school (EFZ) in IT, computer science, engineering, or a related field Comfortable working with people   and with   following established procedures   and   you are passionate about making things better Basic understanding of computer hardware and operating systems Eager to learn and develop technical skills in a hands ‑ on environment Strong problem ‑ solving mindset and good attention to detail Good communication skills in English and German More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti al nostro team di OSS collaborativo e supporta le operazioni IT quotidiane vicino al business. Garantisci ai dipendenti di avere dispositivi affidabili e un'esperienza di lavoro digitale fluida. In questo ruolo pratico, impari come risolvere problemi tecnici e preparare attrezzature IT essenziali. Si lavora a stretto contatto con gli utenti finali e ottenere preziose informazioni su come l'IT guida la produttività. Durante i 12 mesi di stage, colleghi esperti sostengono la vostra crescita e sviluppo. Come farete un impatto Assist nella risoluzione dei problemi IT di base, nel ripristino dei computer portatili e di altri dispositivi in modo che siano pronti per l'uso da parte di dipendenti nuovi o esistenti Supporta gli utenti finali nella navigazione di strumenti di self-service e procedure IT standard Assistere con la gestione delle scorte, il recupero degli asset\/ritorno e la preparazione dei dispositivi per i problemi di bordo\/offboarding Processi di garanzia di supporto raccogliendo informazioni e preparando i dispositivi IT Essere impegnato in progetti speciali in cui si effettua l'impatto (locazione, cambiamento dell'assetto dell'ufficio, istituire infrastrutture, impostare le sale riunioni) Essere impegnato in progetti speciali sul sito, come rilocali per uffici, modifiche ai layout per uffici, installazione delle infrastrutture, preparazione o riconfigurazione delle sale riunioni, contribuendo direttamente a come funziona il luogo di lavoro Attualmente studiando presso una scuola universitaria o tecnica (EFZ) in IT, informatica, ingegneria o un campo correlato Lavorare con le persone e con le seguenti procedure consolidate e si è appassionati di rendere le cose migliori La comprensione di base dell'hardware e dei sistemi operativi Eager per imparare e sviluppare competenze tecniche in una mani ‐ su ambiente Forte problema ‐ risolvere mindset e buona attenzione ai dettagli Buone capacità di comunicazione in inglese e tedesco Più su di noi Siamo una società di sviluppo continuo con un forte focus
• Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicato, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda, tra cui una breve lettera di copertura e una trascrizione di record, insieme al vostro CV. Cittadini non UE/AELS, si prega di notare che un certificato universitario ufficiale che mostra che uno stage è una parte obbligatoria dei vostri studi è richiesto.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Treten Sie unserem kollaborativen OSS-Team bei und unterstützen Sie den täglichen IT-Betrieb in der Nähe des Unternehmens. Sie stellen sicher, dass Mitarbeiter über zuverlässige Geräte und ein reibungsloses digitales Arbeitsplatzerlebnis verfügen. In dieser praktischen Rolle lernen Sie, wie Sie technische Probleme beheben und wichtige IT-Geräte vorbereiten können. Sie arbeiten eng mit Endbenutzern zusammen und gewinnen wertvolle Erkenntnisse darüber, wie IT die Produktivität antreibt. Während des 12-monatigen Praktikums unterstützen erfahrene Kollegen Ihr Wachstum und Ihre Entwicklung. Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen Assist bei der Fehlersuche grundlegende IT-Probleme, p repare Laptops und andere Geräte, so dass sie bereit sind für den Einsatz durch neue oder bestehende Mitarbeiter Unterstützung Endbenutzer bei der Navigation Self-Service-Tools und Standard-IT-Prozeduren Assist bei der Bestandsabwicklung, Asset Pickup / Return und Gerätevorbereitung für Onboarding Support Garantieprozesse durch das Sammeln von Informationen und Vorbereitung von Geräten Hilfe bei der Wartung IT-Ausrüstung in Besprechungsräumen und gemeinsam genutzten Büroräumen, um sicherzustellen, dass Systeme korrekt funktionieren Aktualisieren Sie die Dokumentation in Bezug auf Gerätevorbereitung und OSS-Verfahren und melden Sie Probleme an das Team. Beteiligen Sie sich an speziellen Projekten, bei denen Sie etwas bewirken (Umzug, Änderung der Büroeinrichtung, Einrichtung der Infrastruktur, Einrichtung der Besprechungsräume) Beteiligen Sie sich an speziellen Projekten vor Ort, wie Büroverlagerungen, Änderungen an Bürolayouts, Infrastruktureinrichtung und Vorbereitung oder Neukonfiguration von Besprechungsräumen, die direkt dazu beitragen, wie der Arbeitsplatz funktioniert Ihr Hintergrund Derzeit studieren an einer Universität oder technischen Schule (EFZ) in IT, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich Komfortable Arbeit mit Menschen und mit den folgenden etablierten Verfahren und Sie sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, die Dinge besser Grundlegendes Verständnis von Computer-Hardware und Betriebssystemen Eager zu lernen und zu entwickeln technische Fähigkeiten in einer Hand - auf Umwelt Starke Problemlösung Denkweise und gute Aufmerksamkeit zum Detail Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Deutsch Mehr über uns Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen mit einem starken Fokus auf Innovation, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und nachhaltige Fertigung.
• Wir bieten flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, engagierte Mentorenschaft und ein unterstützendes, integratives Umfeld, in dem Sie persönlich und beruflich wachsen können - und ermöglichen Ihnen, zu gedeihen und gleichzeitig Leben und Arbeit in Einklang zu bringen. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung, einschließlich eines kurzen Anschreibens und einer Niederschrift der Aufzeichnungen, zusammen mit Ihrem Lebenslauf. Nicht-EU-/EFTA-Bürger, bitte beachten Sie, dass ein offizielles Universitätszertifikat erforderlich ist, aus dem hervorgeht, dass ein Praktikum ein obligatorischer Bestandteil Ihres Studiums ist.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'occasion Joignez-vous à notre équipe collaborative OSS et soutenez des opérations informatiques quotidiennes proches de l'entreprise. Vous vous assurez que les employés ont des appareils fiables et une expérience de travail numérique en douceur. Dans ce rôle pratique, vous apprenez comment résoudre les problèmes techniques et préparer les équipements informatiques essentiels. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les utilisateurs finaux et obtenez des informations précieuses sur la façon dont l'informatique stimule la productivité. Pendant les 12 mois de stage, des collègues expérimentés soutiennent votre croissance et votre développement. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Aider à résoudre les problèmes informatiques de base, à remplacer les ordinateurs portables et autres appareils afin qu'ils soient prêts à être utilisés par des employés nouveaux ou existants Aider les utilisateurs finaux à naviguer des outils d'auto-service et des procédures informatiques standard Aider à la manutention des stocks, à la récupération d'actifs et au retour, et à la préparation des appareils pour les processus de garantie à bord et hors-bord Soutenir les processus de garantie en recueillant de l'information et en préparant des appareils Aider à maintenir l'équipement de TI dans les salles de réunion et les bureaux partagés, en veillant à ce que les systèmes fonctionnent correctement Mettre à jour la documentation relative à la préparation des appareils et aux procédures SSO et signaler les problèmes à l'équipe. S'engager dans des projets spéciaux où vous faites impact (relocalisation, changement d'agencement, mise en place d'infrastructures, mise en place des salles de réunion) S'engager dans des projets spéciaux sur le site, tels que des déménagements de bureaux, des modifications à la disposition des bureaux, la configuration de l'infrastructure et la préparation ou la reconfiguration des salles de réunion, contribuant directement au fonctionnement du lieu de travail Votre expérience Vous étudiez actuellement dans une université ou une école technique (EFZ) en informatique, en informatique, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe Travaillant confortablement avec les gens et en suivant les procédures établies et vous êtes passionné par l'amélioration de la compréhension de base du matériel informatique et des systèmes d'exploitation Evidemment apprendre et développer des compétences techniques dans un environnement ‐ sur l'environnement Problème fort ‐ résoudre l'état d'esprit et une bonne attention aux détails Bonnes compétences en communication en anglais et en allemand Plus sur nous Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie et fortement axée sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable.
• Nous offrons des conditions de travail flexibles, un mentorat dédié et un environnement favorable et inclusif où vous pouvez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement – vous autonomisant à prospérer tout en conciliant vie et travail. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature, y compris une brève lettre de présentation et une transcription des dossiers, ainsi que votre CV. Citoyens non-UE\/AELE, veuillez noter qu'un certificat universitaire officiel indiquant qu'un stage est une partie obligatoire de vos études est requis.

jobs.title: Internship Junior Project Manager GIS 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader that is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We employ more than 40,000 people in 90 countries who each day work with purpose and use their different backgrounds to challenge the status quo. We welcome you to apply today and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation. We operate production facilities in Zurich Oerlikon and ship switchgears all over the world. Therefore, we are looking for an Intern for 12 months as a Junior Project Manager, who helps to bring these large projects to success as well as support our team to improve our day-to-day processes. Join our team! How you'll make an impact Taking over commercial and technical responsibility of one or more GIS customer project(s) (coached by an experienced project manager) Plan project in terms of costs and time schedule Drive engineering phase and make sure that technical issues are resolved quickly prepare and lead meetings with customer Participation in various cost-out projects in collaboration with other departments Improvement of process documentation (workflows, process visualization, continuous improvement process according to lean six sigma principles) Improvement of project management Tools Your background Technical background (BSc or MSc in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering) Knowledge of business administration and excellent communication skills Experienced and interested in working with people at the interface of technology and commercial topics Very good English skills, spoken and written High commitment and ability to adapt to new situations Self-driven personality who is willing to take responsibility More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Senior Project Control Engineer – Power Conversion 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  At our Competence Center “Power Converter Solutions”, we are at the forefront of developing, manufacturing, installing, and commissioning high-power electronic converters for applications such as STATCOM, rail power supply systems, hydro pumped storage systems and grid interconnections.  Our solutions play a key role in enabling the integration of renewable energy into modern power grids while improving overall system efficiency.  To strengthen our Control Engineering team, we are looking for an experienced, motivated and hands-on Senior Project Control Engineer with a strong interest in power electronics and control systems.  If you are a fast learner with a structured and proactive mindset, and you enjoy combining engineering work with real-world applications — this is your opportunity.     How you'll make an impact  Plan and execute control engineering aspects of projects, including hardware and software concepts, specifications, and documentation  Coordinate technical interfaces between customers, sub-suppliers, and internal teams  Define and evaluate hardware interfaces, including electrical components and design reviews  Drive conceptual design, development and support in implementation of control software and testing on real-time simulation platforms  Perform commissioning, testing, and customer training on-site  Provide technical support during project execution and after delivery  Support the sales team in the preparation of technical concepts and tender documentation  Collaborate closely with control, system, and mechanical engineering teams as well as project management     Your background  Degree in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor's or Master's, from a university or university of applied sciences)  Min. 5 years of relevant working experience   Hands-on experience with MATLAB \/ Simulink is essential, with structed text programming and Hidraw as added advantage  Strong knowledge of process and power electronics control and software design (e.g. OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI)   Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g. OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) is a plus  Initial experience in testing, commissioning, or applied engineering is an advantage  Willingness to travel globally for commissioning assignments (approx. 20% of working time)  Fluency in English and German     More about us      Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.     Additionally, you can expect:  Work on cutting-edge technologies in Power Electronics  Hands-on experience in international projects and real-world applications  A combination of simulation, engineering, and on-site project work  Opportunity to grow into a technical expert within a rapidly developing business  Collaboration within a highly skilled, international engineering team

descriptionByLocale.it: Al nostro Competence Center “Power Converter Solutions”, siamo all’avanguardia nello sviluppo, nella produzione, nell’installazione e nella messa in servizio di convertitori elettronici ad alta potenza per applicazioni come STATCOM, sistemi di alimentazione ferroviaria, sistemi di stoccaggio idropompati e interconnessioni a rete. Le nostre soluzioni svolgono un ruolo chiave nel consentire l'integrazione delle energie rinnovabili nelle moderne reti elettriche, migliorando al contempo l'efficienza complessiva del sistema. Per rafforzare il nostro team di Control Engineering, stiamo cercando un esperto, motivato e hands-on Senior Project Control Engineer con un forte interesse per l'elettronica di potenza e sistemi di controllo. Se sei un apprendimento veloce con una mentalità strutturata e proattiva, e ti piace combinare lavoro di ingegneria con applicazioni reali - questa è la tua opportunità. Come farete un piano d'impatto ed eseguire gli aspetti di ingegneria di controllo dei progetti, compresi i concetti hardware e software, le specifiche e la documentazione Coordinate le interfacce tecniche tra i clienti, i sottofornitori e i team interni Definire e valutare le interfacce hardware, compresi i componenti elettrici e le revisioni di progettazione Guida progettazione concettuale, sviluppo e supporto nell'attuazione del software di controllo e test sulle piattaforme di simulazione in tempo reale Simulink è essenziale, con la programmazione di testi struttati e Hidraw come vantaggio aggiunto Forte conoscenza del controllo dell'elettronica di processo e di potenza e del software di progettazione (ad esempio OLC, CLC, Protezione, HMI) Familiarità con i protocolli di comunicazione industriale (ad esempio OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) è un'esperienza iniziale di test, messa in servizio o ingegneria applicata 20% è un vantaggio di viaggio globale. Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere. Inoltre, ci si può aspettare: Lavorare sulle tecnologie all'avanguardia nell'esperienza Power Electronics Hands-on in progetti internazionali e applicazioni nel mondo reale Una combinazione di simulazione, ingegneria e lavoro di progetto in loco Opportunità di crescere in un esperto tecnico all'interno di un business in rapida sviluppo Collaborazione all'interno di un team di ingegneria altamente qualificato e internazionale
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity At our Competence Center “Power Converter Solutions”, we are at the forefront of developing, manufacturing, installing, and commissioning high-power electronic converters for applications such as STATCOM, rail power supply systems, hydro pumped storage systems and grid interconnections. Our solutions play a key role in enabling the integration of renewable energy into modern power grids while improving overall system efficiency. To strengthen our Control Engineering team, we are looking for an experienced, motivated and hands-on Senior Project Control Engineer with a strong interest in power electronics and control systems. If you are a fast learner with a structured and proactive mindset, and you enjoy combining engineering work with real-world applications — this is your opportunity. How you'll make an impact Plan and execute control engineering aspects of projects, including hardware and software concepts, specifications, and documentation Coordinate technical interfaces between customers, sub-suppliers, and internal teams Define and evaluate hardware interfaces, including electrical components and design reviews Drive conceptual design, development and support in implementation of control software and testing on real-time simulation platforms Perform commissioning, testing, and customer training on-site Provide technical support during project execution and after delivery Support the sales team in the preparation of technical concepts and tender documentation Collaborate closely with control, system, and mechanical engineering teams as well as project management Your background Degree in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor's or Master's, from a university or university of applied sciences) Min. 5 years of relevant working experience Hands-on experience with MATLAB \/ Simulink is essential, with structed text programming and Hidraw as added advantage Strong knowledge of process and power electronics control and software design (e.g. OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI) Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g. OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) is a plus Initial experience in testing, commissioning, or applied engineering is an advantage Willingness to travel globally for commissioning assignments (approx. 20% of working time) Fluency in English and German More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. Additionally, you can expect: Work on cutting-edge technologies in Power Electronics Hands-on experience in international projects and real-world applications A combination of simulation, engineering, and on-site project work Opportunity to grow into a technical expert within a rapidly developing business Collaboration within a highly skilled, international engineering team
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance In unserem Competence Center „Power Converter Solutions sind wir an der Spitze der Entwicklung, Herstellung, Installation und Inbetriebnahme von elektronischen Hochleistungswandlern für Anwendungen wie STATCOM, Schienenstromversorgungssysteme, hydrogepumpte Speichersysteme und Netzanbindungen. Unsere Lösungen spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Integration erneuerbarer Energien in moderne Stromnetze bei gleichzeitiger Verbesserung der Gesamtsystemeffizienz. Um unser Control Engineering Team zu stärken, suchen wir einen erfahrenen, motivierten und praxisnahen Senior Project Control Engineer mit starkem Interesse an Leistungselektronik und Steuerungssystemen. Wenn Sie ein schneller Lernender mit einer strukturierten und proaktiven Denkweise sind und es genießen, Ingenieurarbeit mit realen Anwendungen zu kombinieren, ist dies Ihre Chance. Wie Sie einen Impact Planen und Ausführen von steuerungstechnischen Aspekten von Projekten, einschließlich Hard- und Softwarekonzepten, Spezifikationen und Dokumentation Koordinieren Sie technische Schnittstellen zwischen Kunden, Unterlieferanten und internen Teams Definieren und bewerten Sie Hardware-Schnittstellen, einschließlich elektrischer Komponenten und Design-Reviews Fahren Sie konzeptionelles Design, Entwicklung und Unterstützung bei der Implementierung von Steuerungssoftware und Tests auf Echtzeit-Simulationsplattformen Durchführung von Inbetriebnahme, Test und Kundenschulung vor Ort Unterstützen Sie das Verkaufsteam bei der Vorbereitung von technischen Konzepten und Ausschreibungsdokumentation Arbeiten Sie eng mit Steuerungs-, System- und Maschinenbauteams zusammen sowie Projektmanagement Ihr Hintergrundstudium in Elektrotechnik (Bachelor oder Master, von einer Universität oder Fachhochschule) Min. 5 Jahre relevante Arbeitserfahrung Simulink ist unerlässlich, mit strukturierter Textprogrammierung und Hidraw als zusätzlichen Vorteil Starke Kenntnisse der Prozess- und Leistungselektroniksteuerung und des Softwaredesigns (z. B. OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI) Vertrautheit mit industriellen Kommunikationsprotokollen (z. B. OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) ist ein Plus Erste Erfahrung in Testen, Inbetriebnahme oder angewandtes Engineering ist ein Vorteil Bereitschaft, weltweit für Inbetriebnahmeaufträge zu reisen (ca. 20% der Arbeitszeit) Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können. Darüber hinaus können Sie erwarten: Arbeiten an innovativen Technologien in Power Electronics Praktische Erfahrung in internationalen Projekten und realen Anwendungen Eine Kombination aus Simulation, Engineering und Projektarbeit vor Ort Gelegenheit, in einem sich schnell entwickelnden Business zum technischen Experten zu werden Zusammenarbeit in einem hochqualifizierten, internationalen Engineering-Team
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Au sein de notre Centre de Compétences, nous sommes à l'avant-garde du développement, de la fabrication, de l'installation et de la mise en service de convertisseurs électroniques haute puissance pour des applications telles que STATCOM, les systèmes d'alimentation électrique ferroviaire, les systèmes de stockage hydropompés et les interconnexions de réseau. Nos solutions jouent un rôle clé dans l'intégration des énergies renouvelables dans les réseaux électriques modernes tout en améliorant l'efficacité globale du système. Pour renforcer notre équipe d'ingénierie de contrôle, nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur principal de contrôle de projet expérimenté, motivé et pratique avec un grand intérêt pour l'électronique de puissance et les systèmes de contrôle. Si vous êtes un apprenant rapide avec un état d'esprit structuré et proactif, et vous aimez combiner le travail d'ingénierie avec des applications du monde réel — c'est votre opportunité. Comment faire un impact Planifier et exécuter les aspects techniques de contrôle des projets, y compris les concepts matériels et logiciels, les spécifications et la documentation Coordonner les interfaces techniques entre les clients, les sous-fournisseurs et les équipes internes Définir et évaluer les interfaces matérielles, y compris les composants électriques et les examens de conception Conduire la conception conceptuelle, le développement et le soutien dans la mise en œuvre des logiciels de contrôle et les essais sur les plates-formes de simulation en temps réel Effectuer la mise en service, les essais et la formation des clients sur place Fournir un soutien technique pendant l'exécution du projet et après la livraison Soutenir l'équipe de vente dans la préparation des concepts techniques et la documentation d'appel d'offres Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de contrôle, de système et d'ingénierie mécanique ainsi qu'avec la gestion de projet Vos antécédents en génie électrique (Bachelor's ou Master's, d'une université ou d'une université des sciences appliquées) Simulink est essentiel, avec une programmation textuelle structurée et Hidraw comme avantage supplémentaire Une bonne connaissance du contrôle électronique des processus et de la puissance et de la conception de logiciels (p. ex. CLO, CLC, Protection, HMI) La connaissance des protocoles de communication industrielle (p. ex. COI, CIE 61850, CIE 60870-5-104, DNP3) est une expérience plus initiale dans le test, la mise en service ou l'ingénierie appliquée est un avantage La volonté de voyager à l'échelle mondiale pour des missions de mise en service (environ 20 % du temps de travail) La fluidité en anglais et en allemand Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir. De plus, vous pouvez vous attendre : Travail sur les technologies de pointe dans l'électronique de puissance Expérience pratique dans les projets internationaux et les applications réelles Une combinaison de travaux de simulation, d'ingénierie et de projet sur place Possibilité de devenir un expert technique au sein d'une entreprise en développement rapide Collaboration au sein d'une équipe d'ingénierie internationale hautement qualifiée

jobs.title: Assembler 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Die Möglichkeit In dieser spannenden Position als Assembler hast du die Chance, aktiv an der Montage von Hochspannungsdurchführungen mitzuwirken und dabei höchste Qualitätsstandards umzusetzen. Du arbeitest selbstständig nach technischen Unterlagen und trägst durch deine präzise und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise zur termingerechten Fertigung komplexer Baugruppen bei. Deine Erfahrung in der Maschinenmontage sowie dein Verantwortungsbewusstsein machen dich zu einem wichtigen Teil eines engagierten Teams. Nutze die Möglichkeit, in einem flexiblen Arbeitsumfeld deine Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung der Montage von Hochspannungsdurchführungen gemäss den in den Qualitätssicherungsverfahren und Arbeitsanweisungen festgehaltenen Vorgaben und Zielsetzungen Arbeiten nach Arbeitspapieren wie Kundenaufträge, technischen Unterlagen, Checkliste und Arbeitsplan Melden von Fehlern, Unstimmigkeiten an direkten Vorgesetzten Termingerechte und wirtschaftliche Montage der Baugruppen und Schaltersysteme Einhaltung der festgehaltenen QS-Richtlinien Schwachstellen erkennen, richtig stellen und an Vorgesetzten melden Einhaltung des Ablaufs für Fehlerbehebung Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Polymechaniker\/in o.ä Praktische und theoretische Erfahrung in der Maschinenmontage Gute Kenntnisse im Lesen von Zeichnungsunterlagen und Arbeitspapieren Verantwortungs- und qualitätsbewusste Persönlichkeit Flexibilität, Ausdauer sowie Zielstrebigkeit runden dein Profil ab Bereitschaft zu 2-3 Schichtbetrieb Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptionByLocale.it: In questa posizione emozionante come assemblatore, si ha la possibilità di partecipare attivamente all'assemblaggio di boccole ad alta tensione e implementare i più elevati standard di qualità. Lavorate in modo indipendente secondo i documenti tecnici e contribuite attraverso il vostro metodo di lavoro preciso e affidabile alla produzione in tempo reale di assemblaggi complessi. La tua esperienza nell'assemblaggio di macchine e il tuo senso di responsabilità ti rendono una parte importante di un team impegnato. Approfitta dell'opportunità di sviluppare le tue competenze in un ambiente di lavoro flessibile e crescere insieme a noi. È possibile raggiungere questo obiettivo effettuando l'assemblaggio di boccole ad alta tensione in base alle specifiche e agli obiettivi stabiliti nelle procedure di garanzia della qualità e istruzioni di lavoro Lavorare secondo documenti di lavoro come ordini del cliente, documenti tecnici, checklist e piano di lavoro Reporting di errori, incongruenze sul programma e l'assemblaggio economico delle assemblee e sistemi di commutazione conformità con le linee guida QA stabilite Riconoscere le carenze, correggere e riferire ai supervisorimenti per il processo di conformità Questo ti porta con un apprendistato professionale completato come un'esperienza polimeccanica\/in o simile Esperienza pratica e teorica nell'assemblaggio di macchine Buona conoscenza nella lettura di documenti di disegno e documenti di lavoro Responsabilità e personalità coscienti di qualità Flessibilità, resistenza e determinazione intorno al tuo profilo da disponibilità a 2-3 turni operazione Più su di noi I nostri metodi di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le tue prestazioni personali e professionali, e creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptionByLocale.en: In this exciting position as an assembler, you have the chance to actively participate in the assembly of high-voltage bushings and implement the highest quality standards. You work independently according to technical documents and contribute through your precise and reliable working method to the on-time production of complex assemblies. Your experience in machine assembly and your sense of responsibility make you an important part of a committed team. Take advantage of the opportunity to develop your skills in a flexible working environment and grow together with us. You can achieve this by carrying out the assembly of high-voltage bushings according to the specifications and objectives laid down in the quality assurance procedures and work instructions Work according to working papers such as customer orders, technical documents, checklist and work plan Reporting of errors, inconsistencies on schedule and economical assembly of the assemblies and switch systems Compliance with the established QA guidelines Recognize weaknesses, correct and report to supervisors Compliance with the process for troubleshooting This brings you with completed vocational apprenticeship as a polymechanic\/in or similar Practical and theoretical experience in machine assembly Good knowledge in reading drawing documents and working papers Responsibility and quality-conscious personality Flexibility, endurance and determination round your profile from readiness to 2-3 shift operation More about us Our flexible working methods help you to optimize your personal and professional performance, and create an environment in which all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.description:

Du sorgst dafür, dass Materialien und Produkte sicher, effizient und termingerecht bewegt, gelagert und dokumentiert werden. Dabei kombinierst du praktische Lagerarbeit mit dem Einsatz moderner Hilfsmittel wie Gabelstapler oder Förderanlagen. Das kannst du bewirken Be- und Entladen von Materialien mittels Kran Kommissionieren, Verpacken und Versandvorbereitung von Aufträgen Bedienen von Flurförderfahrzeugen (z. B. Gabelstapler, Hubwagen) und Fördertechnik Materialbewegungen im SAP Pflege der Lagerbestände im IT-System Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung von Lager- und Logistikprozessen Unterstützung und Einarbeitung von Kolleg:innen mit weniger Erfahrung Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Logistiker EFZ oder mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung im Lager Staplerausweis und Erfahrung im Umgang mit Flurförderfahrzeugen von Vorteil Kranausweis von Vorteil Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Lagerverwaltungssystemen (SAP) wünschenswert Sorgfältige, zuverlässige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität und Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil Mehr über uns Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einem modernen und organisierten Lagerumfeld Abwechslungsreiche

Combinate il lavoro pratico di stoccaggio con l'uso di strumenti moderni come carrelli elevatori o sistemi di trasporto. You combine practical storage work with the use of modern tools such as forklifts or conveyor systems. You can bring about this loading and unloading of materials by means of crane picking, packing and shipping preparation of orders Operation of forklift vehicles (e.g. forklifts, trucks) and conveying technology Material movements in SAP Maintenance of the stocks in the IT system Participation in the optimization of warehouse and logistics processes Support and familiarization of Kolleg:innen with less experience This brings you with completed training as a logistician EFZ or several years of practical experience in the warehouse forklift ID and experience in handling forklift vehicles of advantage Crane ID of advantage Knowledge in handling warehouse management systems (SAP) desirable Careful, reliable and responsible working method Teamwork ability, flexibility and willingness to take on responsibility Good German skills in word and writing; Knowledge of English More about us A secure workplace in a modern and organized warehouse environment

jobs.title: Troubleshooting Process Quality Technician 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Der Bereich GIS (Gasisolierte Schaltanlagen) steht für höchste Qualität, Sicherheit und Effizienz – und genau hier setzt deine Rolle an. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du eine zentrale Funktion in der Bearbeitung und Koordination von Qualitätsmeldungen in der Produktion. Du erkennst Probleme frühzeitig, analysierst sie strukturiert und sorgst für nachhaltige Lösungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit verschiedenen internen Stakeholdern zusammen und trägst aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse bei. Das kannst du bewirken Du bist die erste Eskalationsstufe für die Produktion und arbeitest eng mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen. Verantwortlich für die Erstellung und Koordination von Qualitätsmeldungen (QN) in der Produktion Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards Priorisierung von Qualitätsmeldungen (Q-Meldungen) Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Abteilungen wie Produktion, Qualität, Engineering, Planung, Projektleitung und Einkauf Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung von Troubleshooting Prozessen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung Unterstützung bei Audits und internen Reviews Das bringst du mit Technische Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Qualität Erfahrung im Troubleshooting, Produktionsprozesse oder in Qualitätsmanagement Analytisches Denken, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und hohe Problemlösungskompetenz Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Entscheidungsfähigkeit Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Kenntnisse in SAP und MES Detaillierte Produktkenntnisse im Bereich Gas Isolierte Schaltanlagen Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir an die Kraft der Vielfalt, Zusammenarbeit und Innovation. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von kontinuierlichem Lernen und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, nachhaltige Energielösungen zu gestalten. Wir fördern ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem jede Meinung zählt und du deine Ideen einbringen kannst – unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht oder Hintergrund.

jobs.title: Global Product Specialist Transformer Bushings
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously

jobs.title: Photolithography Process Technician 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join a high-performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Photolithography Process Technician, you will play a key role in supporting the development, optimization, and stabilization of photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. You will work with advanced lithography equipment, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and help ensure high-quality production standards. This is an opportunity to contribute to process improvements, support technical decision-making, and drive enhancements in stability, uptime, and overall process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! How you'll make an impact Ensure stable and efficient production operations in the photolithography area Perform and support process verifications, qualifications, and releases in accordance with established requirements Analyze and resolve process deviations and support investigations related to quality issues and customer complaints Create and maintain work instructions, process documentation, and training materials Organize and conduct training sessions and certifications for production employees Support process changes, equipment projects, and capacity expansion initiatives Initiate and follow up on ZBA, SCR, and NMR processes, and support CAR and ECR activities Actively participate in continuous improvement (CIP\/KVP), 6S, and safety initiatives Participate in shop floor meetings and on-call duty (standby service) Your background Completed technical education (e.g., Microtechnician, Electronics Technician, Automation Technician, Chemical Technician, Process Technician) or a comparable qualification, or several years of professional experience in an industrial production environment, preferably in the semiconductor industry or photolithography Experience in analyzing and resolving process and quality-related issues Confident handling of technical documentation, work instructions, and standardized processes Structured, independent, and solution-oriented working style with a strong sense of responsibility Enjoy working collaboratively with Production, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams Strong communication and training skills, with the ability to convey knowledge clearly and effectively High level of quality, safety, and continuous improvement awareness Good written and spoken German; English skills are an advantage Willingness to participate in an on-call duty rotation More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a un team di fotolitografia altamente performante in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero un impatto. Come Tecnico di Processo di Fotolitografia, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nel sostenere lo sviluppo, l'ottimizzazione e la stabilizzazione dei processi di fotolitografia utilizzati nella produzione di semiconduttori. Potrai lavorare con apparecchiature di litografia avanzate, collaborare con team interfunzionali, e contribuire a garantire standard di produzione di alta qualità. Questa è un'opportunità per contribuire a migliorare il processo, sostenere il processo decisionale tecnico, e migliorare l'azionamento in stabilità, uptime e prestazioni di processo generale. descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity Join a high-performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. This is an opportunity to contribute to process improvements, support technical decision-making, and drive enhancements in stability, uptime, and overall process performance. jobs.title: Assistant to Head of Government & Institutional Relations- maternity cover (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Are you an experienced, agile and hands-on Executive Assistant who thrives in a dynamic, international environment? We are looking for a versatile Executive Assistant to provide dedicated support to Global Head of Government and Institutional Relations. This temporary maternity cover role (1 year contract) offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the success of a highly visible global function. 
• Your responsibilities Provide proactive support to the Global Head of Government and Institutional Relations, including calendar management, meeting coordination, travel arrangements, visas, and accommodations. Act as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, handling inquiries with professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment. Research, compile, verify, and prepare presentations, reports, correspondence, organizational charts, and other business-critical documentation. Support communication activities across the Government & Institutional Relations function, ensuring effective information sharing and stakeholder alignment. Support digital collaboration and communication platforms, including virtual meetings, webinars, SharePoint, intranet content, and newsletters. Implement Hitachi Energy processes and contribute to the continuous improvement of administrative procedures and ways of working. Organize business-critical meetings and events while providing administrative and financial support related to travel, expenses, purchase orders, invoices, and budget tracking. Your background Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in an Executive Assistant role supporting senior leaders in a complex international environment. Exceptional organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with a service-oriented mindset. Proven ability to work independently, anticipate needs, take initiative, and handle confidential information with the highest level of integrity. Strong digital proficiency, including Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), SharePoint, virtual collaboration tools, and webinar platforms. Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken. Additional language skills are considered an advantage

jobs.title: Senior System Engineer - Power Converters 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is a pioneer and the recognized market leader in the Power Conversion and FACTS (flexible alternating current transmission systems) field. Our power converter solutions team develops and implements power electronics-based equipment and systems - including Static Compensators (STATCOMs) and Static Frequency Converters (SFC) - in the power range up to 150 MVA and above. Our solutions support power utilities and industries and serve applications including railway power supplies, hydro pumped-storage power plants, grid interties as well as static compensation for renewables. To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced Senior System Engineer with strong background in power electronics, power systems and system simulations. If you want to work at the forefront of energy technology in a motivated, global engineering environment, this role is for you. How you'll make an impact Design power electronic converter systems including Static Frequency Converters (SFC), Static Compensators (STAT-COMs), etc., from sales and tendering phase to project execution, including occasional customer and site visits Own the system engineering scope throughout project execution, in close collaboration with Sales, other Engineering departments, Project Management, and Service Perform system design tasks such as simulations (e.g., harmonics, transients), performance calculations, component specifications for sub-suppliers, control and protection definitions, and documentation of design activities Ensure compliance with applicable standards, customer specifications and grid codes Identify risks and opportunities, proposing effective mitigation measures Work closely with R&D teams on system design and modeling of converter systems Define and evaluate on-site performance measurements Contribute to the continuous development of engineering processes by sharing knowledge, participating in conferences and committees Your background Master's degree or PhD in electrical engineering or equivalent, with a focus on Power Systems and Power Electronics, combined with solid knowledge in power electronics and\/or power systems with relevant experience in the industry Experience in hydropower or railway sector is a strong plus Strong experience in power electronics and power system simulations Eagerness to take responsibility for deliverables, both internally and externally towards customers and sub-suppliers Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a dynamic and multicultural environment Curiosity and drive for continuous development in both short and long term Fluent in English; German or additional languages are an advantage Willingness to travel globally (<10%) More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Hitachi Energy è un pioniere e leader di mercato riconosciuto nel campo Power Conversion e FACTS (flessibile alternando sistemi di trasmissione attuali) . Il nostro team di soluzioni di convertitore di potenza sviluppa e implementa apparecchiature e sistemi basati su elettronica di potenza - compresi i Compensatori statici (STATCOMs) e i Convertitori di frequenza statici (SFC) - nella gamma di potenza fino a 150 MVA e sopra. Le nostre soluzioni supportano l'utilizzo di energia elettrica e le industrie e servono applicazioni tra cui alimentatori ferroviari, centrali idroelettriche a pompaggio, intere reti e compensazione statica per le rinnovabili. Per rafforzare il nostro team, stiamo cercando un esperto Senior System Engineer con un forte background in elettronica di potenza, sistemi di potenza e simulazioni di sistema. Se si desidera lavorare all'avanguardia della tecnologia energetica in un ambiente di ingegneria globale motivato, questo ruolo è per voi. Come farete un impatto Progettazione sistemi di convertitori elettronici di potenza tra cui Convertitori di frequenza statici (SFC), Compensatori statici (STAT-COMs), ecc, dalla fase di vendita e di tendering all'esecuzione del progetto, comprese occasionali visite del cliente e del sito Realizzare il campo di applicazione dell'ingegneria del sistema in tutta l'esecuzione del progetto, in stretta collaborazione con Vendite, altri dipartimenti di ingegneria, Project Management e Service Perform compiti di progettazione del sistema come simulazioni (ad esempio, armoniche, transienti), calcoli delle prestazioni, specifiche dei componenti per le definizioni dei sotto-fornitori, di controllo e di protezione e documentazione delle attività di progettazione Garantire la conformità con gli standard applicabili, le specifiche del cliente e i codici di griglia Identificare i rischi e le opportunità, proporre misure di mitigazione efficaci Il tuo background Master's Degree o PhD in ingegneria elettrica o equivalente, con un focus su Power Systems e Power Electronics, combinato con solida conoscenza in elettronica di potenza e\/o sistemi di potenza con esperienza rilevante nel settore dell'energia L'esperienza nel settore idroelettrico o ferroviario è una forte e forte esperienza nell'elettronica di potenza e simulazioni di sistema di potenza La voglia di assumersi la responsabilità per i materiali consegnabili, sia internamente che esternamente verso i clienti e subfornitori competenze di comunicazione globali Crediamo che il grande lavoro prosperi in un ambiente in cui le persone si sentono sinceramente sostenute e abbastanza ricompensate. I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo – il rifornimento di impegno, le prestazioni e la crescita. Con la priorità del benessere, costruiamo un posto di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme.

Oberwellen, Transienten), Leistungsberechnungen, Komponentenspezifikationen für Unterlieferanten, Kontroll- und Schutzdefinitionen und Dokumentation von Design-Aktivitäten Sicherstellen Sie die Einhaltung der geltenden Standards, Kundenspezifikationen und Grid-Codes Identifizieren Sie Risiken und Chancen und schlagen Sie effektive Minderungsmaßnahmen vor Arbeiten Sie eng mit F & E-Teams an Systemdesign und Modellierung von Konvertersystemen Definieren und bewerten Sie die Leistungsmessungen vor Ort Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Entwicklung von Engineering-Prozessen durch Wissensaustausch, Teilnahme an Konferenzen und Ausschüssen Ihr Hintergrund Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Elektrotechnik oder gleichwertig, mit einem Schwerpunkt auf Power Systems und Power Electronics, kombiniert mit soliden Kenntnissen in Leistungselektronik und / oder Energiesystemen mit relevanter Erfahrung in der Industrie Erfahrung in der Wasserkraft oder Eisenbahn ist ein starkes Plus Starke Erfahrung in Leistungselektronik und Energiesystemsimulationen Eagerness, Verantwortung für Leistungen zu übernehmen, sowohl intern als auch extern gegenüber Kunden und Unterlieferanten Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen und multikulturellen Umfeld zu arbeiten Neugier und Antrieb für kontinuierliche Entwicklung sowohl kurz- als auch langfristig fließend Englisch; Deutsch oder zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein Vorteil Bereitschaft, global zu reisen (<10%) Wir glauben, dass großartige Arbeit in einem Umfeld gedeiht, in dem sich die Menschen wirklich unterstützt und fair belohnt fühlen. jobs.title: Tender and Quotation Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. To strengthen our operations, we are looking for a Tender and Quotation Specialist (commercial) to join our team at our MICAFIL bushing factory in Switzerland.  In this role, you will be part of an international team focusing on translating customer needs and challenges into competitive bids and quotations. You'll work closely with our sales and other internal teams to ensure that we offer the best solutions to meet our customers' needs around the globe. If you are passionate about preparing tenders and bids and want to actively contribute, join our team! How you'll make an impact Analyze Request for Quotations (RFQs), and other tender documents to understand client requirements, scope of work, and technical specifications with alignment with the Sales team Collaborate with sales, engineering, legal, and other internal departments to gather necessary information, technical details, and cost estimates for tender submissions Develop comprehensive and well-structured tender and quotation documents, including technical proposals, drawings, commercial offers and supporting documentation Ensure all submissions are accurate, complete, and meet the specified deadlines and submission protocols May participate in pre-bid meetings, client clarifications, and negotiations as required Maintain a systematic record of all tender activities, submissions, and outcomes, for quotations and order checklists preparation and handover Continuously improve tender processes and documentation templates to enhance efficiency and quality Coordinate with internal stakeholders for optimal solutions. Proactively maintain clear and structured communication with customers and the internal teams throughout the tendering process Your background Technical (vocational, such as apprenticeship) or commercial education background Minimum of 3 years of administrative\/business experience in tendering activities, quotation preparation and price calculation, or bid coordination, internal sales support, or project management within an industrial or technical environment Proven experience in formulating accurate bids and quotations Strong understanding of tender processes, contractual terms, and commercial aspects Excellent written and verbal communication skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and experience with tender management software or CRM systems Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to details and solution-driven approach Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German and other languages is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Team Leader Incoming Quality Control 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about quality, leadership, and continuous improvement? Would you like to play a key role in ensuring that only high-quality materials enter our switchgear factories for High Voltage Gas-Insulated Switchgear (GIS) and Generator Circuit Breakers (GCB)? As Team Leader Incoming Quality Control (IQC), you will lead a team of quality professionals and help shape our incoming inspection processes. Working closely with operations, supply chain management, suppliers, and customers, you will help ensure quality from the very beginning of the value chain. At Hitachi Energy, we support your professional and personal growth through flexible work practices, continuous learning opportunities, and career development. Join us and help strengthen our culture of quality. How you'll make an impact In this role, you will mainly : Lead, coach, and develop a team of 15-20 IQC professionals while driving the operational and strategic development of the function. Act as site responsible and ensure adherence to the relevant standards. Serve as the main contact for urgent quality issues and ensure fast, effective communication with operations, suppliers, and customers. Develop,  and improve inspection plans for incoming materials. Promote a culture of quality and continuous improvement by using data, KPIs, and visual management tools. Build strong relationships across the organization and strengthen collaboration with key stakeholders. Recruit, develop, mentor, and support quality professionals while ensuring effective succession planning. Ensure that measurement equipment is maintained, calibrated, and available for reliable inspection activities. Drive improvement initiatives together with production, logistics, R&D, sourcing, and other functions to achieve sustainable quality improvements. Your background To be successful in this role, you bring: A Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. More than five years of experience in quality management, project management, program management, or similar functions. Leadership experience or a strong interest in leading and developing people. Experience in quality management, manufacturing operations, lean principles, continuous improvement, and visual management. Six Sigma Green Belt certification is an advantage. Strong communication skills in German and English, both written and spoken. Good knowledge of SAP, ideally in an SAP S\/4HANA environment. More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con operazioni, gestione della supply chain, fornitori e clienti, vi aiuterà a garantire la qualità fin dall'inizio della catena del valore. In Hitachi Energy, sosteniamo la vostra crescita professionale e personale attraverso pratiche di lavoro flessibili, opportunità di apprendimento continuo e sviluppo di carriera. Unisciti a noi e contribuire a rafforzare la nostra cultura della qualità. Esperienza nella gestione della qualità, nelle operazioni di produzione, nei principi magre, nel miglioramento continuo e nella gestione visiva. La certificazione Six Sigma Green Belt è un vantaggio. Forte capacità di comunicazione in tedesco e inglese, sia scritto che parlato. Buona conoscenza di SAP, idealmente in un ambiente SAP S\/4HANA. Crediamo che il grande lavoro prosperi in un ambiente in cui le persone si sentono sinceramente sostenute e abbastanza ricompensate. I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo – il rifornimento di impegno, le prestazioni e la crescita. Con la priorità del benessere, costruiamo un posto di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme.

jobs.title: Master's Thesis Thermal Engineering 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Are you passionate about thermal engineering, simulation, and sustainable energy solutions? In this master's thesis, you will contribute to the development of next-generation dry-type transformer enclosures used in critical indoor and outdoor applications. Working closely with experienced engineers, you will investigate heat transfer, airflow management, and enclosure design using advanced CFD simulation methods. You will gain hands-on experience in solving real industrial challenges while developing expertise in thermal optimization, product development, and engineering analysis. This is a unique opportunity to combine academic research with practical application and make a meaningful contribution to future transformer technologies. The title of the thesis will be: Thermal Optimization of Dry-Type Transformer Enclosures Using CFD: Design of IP55 and NEMA 3R Solutions under AN\/AF Cooling. How you'll make an impact Analyze the current enclosure design concepts for IP55 and NEMA 3R dry-type transformer applications Define CFD simulation models to evaluate airflow distribution, temperature fields, and thermal performance under AN and AF cooling conditions Investigate different design parameters, including finned wall geometry, ventilation strategy, airflow paths, fan-assisted cooling configuration, and material selection Compare alternative enclosure solutions in terms of thermal efficiency, manufacturability, robustness, and compliance with protection requirements Identify critical areas related to heat accumulation, restricted airflow, and possible design limitations Develop engineering recommendations and design guidelines for optimized dry-type transformer enclosures Your background Master's student in Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field Basic knowledge of heat transfer, fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, and mechanical design Interest in numerical simulation, CFD analysis, and industrial product optimization Familiarity with CAD tools and\/or CFD software will be considered an advantage More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

L'opportunità Sei appassionato di ingegneria termica, simulazione e soluzioni energetiche sostenibili? Nella tesi di questo master, contribuirai allo sviluppo di contenitori di trasformatori a secco di nuova generazione utilizzati in applicazioni critiche indoor e outdoor. Lavorando a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri esperti, si indaga il trasferimento di calore, la gestione del flusso d'aria e la progettazione del contenitore utilizzando metodi di simulazione CFD avanzati. Acquisrai esperienza pratica nella soluzione di sfide industriali reali, sviluppando competenze nell'ottimizzazione termica, nello sviluppo dei prodotti e nell'analisi ingegneristica. Questa è un'occasione unica per combinare la ricerca accademica con l'applicazione pratica e dare un contributo significativo alle future tecnologie del trasformatore. Il titolo della tesi sarà: Ottimizzazione termica delle custodie del trasformatore a secco-tipo utilizzando CFD: Progettazione delle soluzioni IP55 e NEMA 3R sotto AN\/AF Cooling. Analizzare i concetti attuali di progettazione dell'alloggiamento per le applicazioni del trasformatore a secco IP55 e NEMA 3R Definire i modelli di simulazione CFD per valutare la distribuzione del flusso d'aria, i campi di temperatura e le prestazioni termiche in condizioni di raffreddamento AN e AF. Lo studente di Master in Ingegneria Meccanica, Ingegneria Energetica, Ingegneria Aerospaziale, o un campo tecnico correlato Conoscenze di base di trasferimento termico, dinamica dei fluidi, termodinamica e progettazione meccanica Interessi in simulazione numerica, analisi CFD e ottimizzazione dei prodotti industriali La familiarità con gli strumenti CAD e il software CFD sarà considerato un vantaggio Più su di noi Siamo una società tecnologica-driven con un forte focus sull'innovazione, il miglioramento continuo e la produzione sostenibile.
• Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicato, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity Are you passionate about thermal engineering, simulation, and sustainable energy solutions? In this master's thesis, you will contribute to the development of next-generation dry-type transformer enclosures used in critical indoor and outdoor applications. Working closely with experienced engineers, you will investigate heat transfer, airflow management, and enclosure design using advanced CFD simulation methods. You will gain hands-on experience in solving real industrial challenges while developing expertise in thermal optimization, product development, and engineering analysis. This is a unique opportunity to combine academic research with practical application and make a meaningful contribution to future transformer technologies. The title of the thesis will be: Thermal Optimization of Dry-Type Transformer Enclosures Using CFD: Design of IP55 and NEMA 3R Solutions under AN\/AF Cooling. How you'll make an impact Analyze the current enclosure design concepts for IP55 and NEMA 3R dry-type transformer applications Define CFD simulation models to evaluate airflow distribution, temperature fields, and thermal performance under AN and AF cooling conditions Investigate different design parameters, including finned wall geometry, ventilation strategy, airflow paths, fan-assisted cooling configuration, and material selection Compare alternative enclosure solutions in terms of thermal efficiency, manufacturability, robustness, and compliance with protection requirements Identify critical areas related to heat accumulation, restricted airflow, and possible design limitations Develop engineering recommendations and design guidelines for optimized dry-type transformer enclosures Your background Master's student in Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field Basic knowledge of heat transfer, fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, and mechanical design Interest in numerical simulation, CFD analysis, and industrial product optimization Familiarity with CAD tools and\/or CFD software will be considered an advantage More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

Die Chance Sie interessieren sich für Wärmetechnik, Simulation und nachhaltige Energielösungen? In dieser Masterarbeit werden Sie zur Entwicklung von Trockentransformatorgehäusen der nächsten Generation beitragen, die in kritischen Innen- und Außenanwendungen verwendet werden. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren untersuchen Sie Wärmeübertragung, Luftstrommanagement und Gehäusedesign mit fortschrittlichen CFD-Simulationsmethoden. Sie erhalten praktische Erfahrung bei der Lösung echter industrieller Herausforderungen und entwickeln Fachwissen in den Bereichen thermische Optimierung, Produktentwicklung und technische Analyse. Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, akademische Forschung mit praktischer Anwendung zu verbinden und einen sinnvollen Beitrag zu zukünftigen Transformatortechnologien zu leisten. Der Titel der Arbeit lautet: Thermische Optimierung von Dry-Type Transformer Enclosures Using CFD: Design of IP55 and NEMA 3R Solutions under AN\/AF Cooling. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Analysieren Sie die aktuellen Gehäusedesignkonzepte für IP55- und NEMA 3R-Trockentransformatoranwendungen Definieren Sie CFD-Simulationsmodelle zur Bewertung der Luftstromverteilung, der Temperaturfelder und der thermischen Leistung unter AN- und AF-Kühlbedingungen Untersuchen Sie verschiedene Designparameter, einschließlich Rippenwandgeometrie, Lüftungsstrategie, Luftstrompfade, lüfterunterstützte Kühlkonfiguration und Materialauswahl Vergleichen Sie alternative Gehäuselösungen in Bezug auf thermische Effizienz, Herstellbarkeit, Robustheit und Einhaltung von Schutzanforderungen Identifizieren Sie kritische Bereiche im Zusammenhang mit Wärmeakkumulation, eingeschränktem Luftstrom und möglichen Designbeschränkungen Entwickeln Sie technische Empfehlungen und Designrichtlinien für optimierte Trockentransformatorgehäuse Ihr Hintergrund Master-Student in Maschinenbau, Energietechnik, Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich Grundkenntnisse der Wärmeübertragung, Fluiddynamik, Thermodynamik und mechanisches Design Interesse an numerischer Simulation, CFD-Analyse und industrielle Produktoptimierung Vertrautheit mit CAD-Tools und / oder CFD-Software wird als Vorteil angesehen Mehr über uns Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen mit einem starken Fokus auf Innovation, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und nachhaltige Fertigung.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité Êtes-vous passionné par l'ingénierie thermique, la simulation et les solutions énergétiques durables? Dans cette thèse de master, vous contribuerez au développement d'enceintes de transformation de type sec de nouvelle génération utilisées dans des applications intérieures et extérieures critiques. En étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs expérimentés, vous étudierez le transfert de chaleur, la gestion du flux d'air et la conception de l'enceinte en utilisant des méthodes de simulation CFD avancées. Vous acquerrez une expérience pratique dans la résolution de vrais défis industriels tout en développant une expertise en optimisation thermique, développement de produits et analyse technique. Il s'agit d'une occasion unique de combiner la recherche universitaire et l'application pratique et d'apporter une contribution significative aux futures technologies de transformation. Le titre de la thèse sera: Optimisation thermique des boîtiers de transformateurs de type sec utilisant CFD: Conception de solutions IP55 et NEMA 3R sous AN\/AF Refroidissement. Comment faire un impact Analyser les concepts actuels de conception de l'enceinte pour les applications de transformateurs à sec IP55 et NEMA 3R Définition de modèles de simulation CFD pour évaluer la distribution du flux d'air, les champs de température et les performances thermiques dans les conditions de refroidissement AN et AF Étudier différents paramètres de conception, y compris la géométrie de la paroi finie, la stratégie de ventilation, les voies de débit d'air, la configuration de refroidissement assistée par le ventilateur et la sélection des matériaux Comparer d'autres solutions d'enceinte en termes d'efficacité thermique, de manufacturabilité, de robustesse et de conformité aux exigences de protection Identifier les zones critiques liées à l'accumulation de chaleur, au flux d'air restreint et aux limitations de conception possibles Élaborer des recommandations techniques et des lignes directrices de conception pour les boîtiers optimisés de transformateurs à sec Votre formation Maîtrise en génie mécanique, en génie de l'énergie, en génie aérospatial ou dans un domaine technique connexe Connaissance de base du transfert de chaleur, de la dynamique des fluides, de la thermodynamique et de la conception mécanique Intérêt pour la simulation numérique, l'analyse CFD et l'optimisation des produits industriels Familiarité avec les outils CAO et/ou les logiciels CFD seront considérés comme un avantage Plus sur nous Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie qui met fortement l'accent sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable.
• Nous offrons des conditions de travail flexibles, un mentorat dédié et un environnement favorable et inclusif où vous pouvez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement – vous autonomisant à prospérer tout en conciliant vie et travail.

jobs.title: Global Tax Operations Lead
jobs.description: The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, we're accelerating the energy transition by building a more sustainable, flexible and secure energy system. As our Global Tax Operations Lead , you will have a unique opportunity to develop, lead and strengthen a recently defined global tax function that serves as the operational backbone of our Tax organisation. In this highly visible leadership role, you will advance, scale and continuously improve a global Tax Operations organisation responsible for delivering compliant, efficient and standardised tax processes across multiple regions. Reporting to the Head of Tax and being part of the Global Tax Leadership Team, you will lead a large international tax operations team focusing on indirect taxes, drive operational excellence, and play a key role in transforming the way tax services are delivered across our global business. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced tax operations leader who thrives in complex multinational environments and is passionate about building high-performing teams, closely partnering with the Global Tax Finance Process Owner to drive process transformation, and delivering operational excellence at scale. Location is flexible, with a preference for the selected candidate to be based in Switzerland. How You'll Make an Impact Lead and strengthen the global Tax Operations function, enhancing its operating model, governance framework, and organizational effectiveness. Drive the execution of consistent, accurate and compliant end-to-end transactional tax processes, thrive continuous improvement in tax compliance, data quality, and reporting effectiveness across all regions. Drive large-scale process transitions, integrations and stabilisation activities while maintaining business continuity throughout transformation programmes. Standardise and optimise tax compliance operations globally, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, controls and scalability. Set and monitor KPIs and quality standards to ensure effective and efficient execution of the tax strategy. Develop a high-performing global team, ensuring effective workforce planning, capability development and resource allocation. Coordinate responses to tax authority audits and inquiries in alignment with the Global Tax Strategy and internal stakeholders. Act as the main escalation point for tax compliance issues and drive timely, sustainable resolution working with tax managers and practice team leaders. Partner closely with tax, finance, IT, legal, supply chain and regional\/local business stakeholders to ensure operational delivery remains aligned with global requirements and business objectives. Your Background Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Finance, Accounting, Tax, Business Administration or a related field. 15+ years of experience in global tax functions, tax process management, shared services, or similar tax operations environments. Demonstrated success leading complex global tax compliance or operational delivery organisations across multiple regions from APAC, Americas and EMEA. Significant people leadership experience, including leading large, geographically dispersed teams of 50+ employees. Strong track record of delivering global process transformation, operating model implementation and tax transformation programmes. Deep experience working with ERP platforms such as SAP S\/4HANA, tax engines, indirect tax compliance tools and other enterprise technologies. Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and successfully operate within complex multinational organisations. What We Are Looking For Strategic operational leader with a strong execution mindset. Passion for continuous improvement, standardisation and operational excellence. Strong governance, risk management and control orientation. Ability to navigate complexity and drive results across multiple regions and stakeholders. Excellent communication, collaboration and change leadership skills. Customer-focused
