descriptionByLocale.it: L'Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, stiamo accelerando la transizione energetica costruendo un sistema energetico più sostenibile, flessibile e sicuro. Come il nostro Global Tax Operations Lead , avrete un'opportunità unica per sviluppare, guidare e rafforzare una funzione fiscale globale recentemente definita che funge da spina dorsale operativa della nostra organizzazione fiscale. In questo ruolo di leadership altamente visibile, si avanza, scala e migliora continuamente un'organizzazione globale di operazioni fiscali responsabile della fornitura di processi fiscali conformi, efficienti e standardizzati in più regioni. Segnalando al capo delle tasse e facendo parte del Global Tax Leadership Team, guiderai un grande team di operazioni fiscali internazionali che si concentra sulle imposte indirette, guida l'eccellenza operativa e svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione del modo in cui i servizi fiscali vengono consegnati in tutto il nostro business globale. Questa è un'opportunità entusiasmante per un leader di operazioni fiscali esperto che prospera in ambienti multinazionali complessi ed è appassionato di costruire squadre ad alto rendimento, collaborando strettamente con il Global Tax Finance Process Owner per guidare la trasformazione del processo, e offrendo l'eccellenza operativa in scala. La posizione è flessibile, con la preferenza per il candidato selezionato che deve essere basato in Svizzera. Come farete un Impact Lead e rafforzare la funzione Operazioni fiscali globali, migliorando il suo modello operativo, il quadro di governance e l'efficacia organizzativa. Guidare l'esecuzione di processi fiscali transazioni coerenti, accurati e conformi, prosperare il miglioramento continuo della conformità fiscale, della qualità dei dati e dell'efficacia di report in tutte le regioni. Guidare transizioni di processo su larga scala, integrazioni e attività di stabilizzazione, mantenendo la continuità aziendale durante i programmi di trasformazione. Standardizzare e ottimizzare le operazioni di compliance fiscale a livello globale, identificare le opportunità per migliorare efficienza, qualità, controlli e scalabilità. Impostare e monitorare i KPI e gli standard di qualità per garantire l'esecuzione efficace ed efficiente della strategia fiscale. Sviluppare un team globale altamente performante, garantendo una pianificazione efficace della forza lavoro, sviluppo delle capacità e allocazione delle risorse. Coordinate le risposte agli audit e alle richieste delle autorità fiscali in linea con la strategia fiscale globale e gli stakeholder interni. Agire come punto di escalation principale per le questioni di conformità fiscale e guidare la risoluzione tempestiva e sostenibile che lavora con i gestori fiscali e i leader del team di pratica. Collaborare a stretto contatto con le parti interessate fiscali, finanziarie, IT, legali, supply chain e regionali\/locali per garantire che la consegna operativa rimanga allineata ai requisiti globali e agli obiettivi aziendali. La tua laurea di primo livello o equivalente in finanza, contabilità, fiscale, amministrazione aziendale o un campo relativo. 15+ anni di esperienza nelle funzioni fiscali globali, gestione dei processi fiscali, servizi condivisi o simili ambienti di operazioni fiscali. Dimostrato successo leader complesso globale di conformità fiscale o organizzazioni di consegna operativa in più regioni da APAC, Americas e EMEA. Esperienza di leadership di persone significative, tra cui squadre disperse di grandi dimensioni geograficamente di 50 dipendenti. Forte track record di fornitura di processi globali di trasformazione, applicazione del modello operativo e programmi di trasformazione fiscale. Profonda esperienza di lavoro con piattaforme ERP come SAP S\/4HANA, motori fiscali, strumenti di compliance fiscale indiretti e altre tecnologie aziendali. Prove capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder senior e operare con successo all'interno di organizzazioni multinazionali complesse. Quello che stiamo cercando leader operativo strategico con una forte mentalità di esecuzione. Passione per il miglioramento continuo, la standardizzazione e l'eccellenza operativa. Forte orientamento di governance, gestione dei rischi e controllo. Capacità di navigare nella complessità e guidare i risultati in più regioni e stakeholder. Ottima capacità di comunicazione, collaborazione e cambiamento di leadership. Concentrati sui clienti

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Chez Hitachi Energy, nous accélérons la transition énergétique en construisant un système énergétique plus durable, plus flexible et plus sûr. En tant que responsable des opérations fiscales mondiales, vous aurez une occasion unique de développer, de diriger et de renforcer une fonction fiscale mondiale récemment définie qui sert de base opérationnelle à notre organisation fiscale. Dans le cadre de ce rôle de leadership très visible, vous progresserez, élargirez et améliorerez continuellement une organisation mondiale des opérations fiscales chargée de fournir des processus fiscaux conformes, efficaces et normalisés dans plusieurs régions. Relevant du chef de la fiscalité et faisant partie de l'équipe de leadership fiscal mondial, vous dirigerez une grande équipe des opérations fiscales internationales axée sur les impôts indirects, stimulerez l'excellence opérationnelle et jouerez un rôle clé dans la transformation de la façon dont les services fiscaux sont offerts dans notre entreprise mondiale. C'est une occasion passionnante pour un chef expérimenté des opérations fiscales qui prospère dans des environnements multinationaux complexes et qui est passionné par la création d'équipes performantes, en étroite collaboration avec le propriétaire du processus de financement fiscal mondial pour stimuler la transformation des processus et offrir l'excellence opérationnelle à l'échelle. L'emplacement est flexible, et le candidat sélectionné préfère être basé en Suisse. Comment vous ferez un impact Diriger et renforcer la fonction des Opérations fiscales mondiales, en améliorant son modèle opérationnel, son cadre de gouvernance et son efficacité organisationnelle. Diriger l'exécution de processus de taxation transactionnelle de bout en bout cohérents, précis et conformes, favoriser l'amélioration continue de la conformité fiscale, de la qualité des données et de l'efficacité des rapports dans toutes les régions. Diriger des transitions, des intégrations et des activités de stabilisation à grande échelle tout en maintenant la continuité des activités tout au long des programmes de transformation. Normaliser et optimiser les opérations de conformité fiscale au niveau mondial, en identifiant les possibilités d'améliorer l'efficacité, la qualité, les contrôles et l'évolutivité. Définir et surveiller les ICR et les normes de qualité pour assurer l'exécution efficace et efficiente de la stratégie fiscale. Mettre sur pied une équipe mondiale performante, assurant une planification efficace des effectifs, le développement des capacités et l'affectation des ressources. Coordonner les réponses aux vérifications et aux enquêtes des autorités fiscales conformément à la Stratégie fiscale mondiale et aux intervenants internes. Agir en tant que principal point d'escalade pour les questions de conformité fiscale et favoriser une résolution rapide et durable en collaboration avec les gestionnaires fiscaux et les chefs d'équipe. Collaborer étroitement avec les partenaires des secteurs de la fiscalité, des finances, de la TI, de la législation, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et des entreprises régionales/locales pour s'assurer que la prestation opérationnelle reste conforme aux exigences mondiales et aux objectifs opérationnels. Votre diplôme de baccalauréat en finances, comptabilité, fiscalité, administration des affaires ou un domaine connexe. 15 ans et plus d'expérience dans les fonctions fiscales mondiales, la gestion des processus fiscaux, les services partagés ou des environnements similaires d'opérations fiscales. Une réussite démontrée à la tête d'organismes complexes de conformité fiscale mondiale ou d'exécution opérationnelle dans plusieurs régions de l'APAC, des Amériques et de l'EMEA. Expérience de leadership de personnes importantes, y compris diriger de grandes équipes dispersées géographiquement de 50 employés et plus. Une solide expérience en matière de transformation des processus mondiaux, de mise en oeuvre de modèles opérationnels et de programmes de transformation fiscale. Expérience approfondie avec les plateformes ERP telles que SAP S\/4HANA, les moteurs fiscaux, les outils de conformité fiscale indirecte et d'autres technologies d'entreprise. Capacité éprouvée d'influencer les acteurs de haut niveau et de fonctionner avec succès au sein d'organisations multinationales complexes. descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di un ingegnere industriale altamente motivato nella nostra produzione con un alto focus sulla produzione magra e l'ottimizzazione del flusso di processo per sviluppare ulteriormente il nostro ambiente di produzione Generator Circuit-Breaker (GCB) a Zurigo. In questo ruolo, si applicano principi di ingegneria industriale, l'automazione e metodi di produzione digitale per migliorare la produttività, la sicurezza, la qualità, l'efficienza dei costi e le prestazioni di consegna in un ambiente di produzione ad alta qualità, a basso volume, ingegneria all'ordine. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nell'analisi e nel miglioramento di complessi concetti di assemblaggio, collaudo, flusso materiale e workstation, supportando allo sviluppo continuo di una magra, digitale e futura fabbrica. Analizzare i layout di produzione GCB attuali, i flussi di lavoro di montaggio, i processi di test, i flussi materiali e le procedure operative per identificare il potenziale di miglioramento in efficienza, sicurezza, qualità, costi e tempi di consegna, con un forte focus sulle opportunità di automazione e digitalizzazione. Progettare e implementare processi di produzione ottimizzati, concetti di workstation, soluzioni di automazione, concetti di utilizzo delle attrezzature, e flusso di materiale migliorato per il montaggio e il test GCB. Condurre studi di tempo e di movimento, mappatura dei processi, analisi del flusso di valore, pianificazione del layout, analisi della capacità e valutazioni del collo di bottiglia per eliminare le attività non-valore aggiunto e aumentare le prestazioni operative. Sviluppare, standardizzare e migliorare le istruzioni di lavoro, le procedure operative standard, la documentazione di produzione e i processi digital shopfloor per le operazioni di montaggio, test e logistica GCB. Valutare, specificare e implementare nuove tecnologie di produzione come sistemi di gestione automatizzati, strumenti intelligenti, istruzioni di lavoro digitali, soluzioni correlate a MES e applicazioni di miglioramento basate sui dati. Sostenere le attività di industrializzazione, la nuova implementazione dei prodotti, le rampe di serie, le iniziative CAPEX, l'approvvigionamento di attrezzature, le attività PFMEA, e l'introduzione di nuovi strumenti, giga, apparecchi e attrezzature di prova. Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di produzione, collaudo, ingegneria, industrializzazione, qualità, supply chain, pianificazione, HSE, project management e product management per garantire miglioramenti di processo robusti e sostenibili. Guidare e partecipare a iniziative di miglioramento continuo, progetti Lean Manufacturing, attività Kaizen, miglioramenti correlati a Six Sigma, ottimizzazione del piano di negozio e iniziative di fabbrica digitale. Mantenere e migliorare i dati master di produzione, gli standard di produzione, le informazioni di routing e la trasparenza delle prestazioni basata su KPI per supportare una pianificazione e l'esecuzione efficienti. Contribuisci allo sviluppo a lungo termine dello stabilimento GCB identificando il potenziale di automazione futuro, migliorando l'ergonomia, rafforzando la sicurezza e consentendo capacità di produzione scalabili. La tua laurea magistrale in Ingegneria dell'automazione, Ingegneria industriale, Ingegneria manifatturiera, Ingegneria meccanica, Ingegneria elettrica, o un campo tecnico correlato. P esperienza professionale in ingegneria industriale, ingegneria della produzione, automazione, industrializzazione, o miglioramento del processo di produzione è preferito. Forte comprensione dell'ottimizzazione dei processi, Lean Manufacturing, metodi di miglioramento continuo, Kaizen, Six Sigma, mappatura del flusso di valore, studi di tempo e controllo dei processi statistici. L'esperienza in ambienti di assemblaggio complessi, prodotti ad alta tensione, produzione di apparecchiature elettriche, produzione di ingegneria all'ordine, o produzione ad alta disponibilità\/basso volume è altamente auspicabile. Buona conoscenza della progettazione delle stazioni di lavoro, pianificazione del layout, concetti di utensili, ergonomia, specificazione delle attrezzature, documentazione di produzione e risoluzione dei problemi strutturati. La familiarità con SAP, MES, istruzioni di lavoro digitali, strumenti di analisi dei dati o cruscotti KPI di produzione è un vantaggio. Forte
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer in our Production with a high focus on Lean Production and Process flow optimiz ation to further develop our Generator Circuit-Breaker (GCB) production environment in Zurich. In this role, you will apply industrial engineering principles, automation, and digital manufacturing approaches to improve productivity, safety, quality, cost efficiency, and delivery performance in a high-variety, low-volume, engineering-to-order manufacturing environment. You will play a key role in analyzing and improving complex GCB assembly, testing, material flow, and workstation concepts, while supporting the continuous development of a lean, digital, and future-ready factory. How you'll make an impact Analyze current GCB production layouts, assembly workflows, testing processes, material flows, and operational procedures to identify improvement potential in efficiency, safety, quality, cost, and lead time, with a strong focus on automation and digitalization opportunities. Design and implement optimized production processes, workstation concepts, automation solutions, equipment utilization concepts, and improved material flow for GCB assembly and testing. Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, value stream analysis, layout planning, capacity analysis, and bottleneck assessments to eliminate non-value-added activities and increase operational performance. Develop, standardize, and improve work instructions, standard operating procedures, manufacturing documentation, and digital shopfloor processes for GCB assembly, testing, and logistics operations. Evaluate, specify, and implement new manufacturing technologies such as automated handling systems, smart tools, digital work instructions, MES-related solutions, and data-driven improvement applications. Support industrialization activities, new product implementation, series ramp-ups, CAPEX initiatives, equipment procurement, PFMEA activities, and the introduction of new tools, jigs, fixtures, and testing equipment. Collaborate closely with production, testing, engineering, industrialization, quality, supply chain, planning, HSE, project management, and product management teams to ensure robust and sustainable process improvements. Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, Lean Manufacturing projects, Kaizen activities, Six Sigma-related improvements, shopfloor optimization, and digital factory initiatives. Maintain and improve manufacturing master data, production standards, routing information, and KPI-based performance transparency to support efficient planning and execution. Contribute to the long-term development of the GCB factory by identifying future automation potential, improving ergonomics, strengthening safety, and enabling scalable production capabilities. Your background Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. P rofessional experience in industrial engineering, production engineering, automation, industrialization, or manufacturing process improvement is preferred . Strong understanding of process optimization, Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement methods, Kaizen, Six Sigma, value stream mapping, time studies, and statistical process control. Experience in complex assembly environments, high-voltage products, electrical equipment manufacturing, engineering-to-order production, or high-variety\/low-volume manufacturing is highly desirable. Good knowledge of workstation design, layout planning, tooling concepts, ergonomics, equipment specification, manufacturing documentation, and structured problem solving. Familiarity with SAP, MES, digital work instructions, data analysis tools, or production KPI dashboards is an advantage. Strong
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten Industrieingenieur in unserer Produktion mit hohem Fokus auf Lean Production und Prozessflussoptimierung, um unsere Generator Circuit-Breaker (GCB) Produktionsumgebung in Zürich weiterzuentwickeln. In dieser Rolle werden Sie Industrial Engineering-Prinzipien, Automatisierung und digitale Fertigungsansätze anwenden, um Produktivität, Sicherheit, Qualität, Kosteneffizienz und Lieferleistung in einer High-Variety, Low-Volume, Engineering-to-Order-Fertigungsumgebung zu verbessern. Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Analyse und Verbesserung komplexer GCB-Montage-, Test-, Materialfluss- und Arbeitsplatzkonzepte und unterstützen gleichzeitig die kontinuierliche Entwicklung einer schlanken, digitalen und zukunftsfähigen Fabrik. Analysieren Sie aktuelle GCB-Produktionslayouts, Montage-Workflows, Testprozesse, Materialflüsse und Betriebsverfahren, um Verbesserungspotenziale in Bezug auf Effizienz, Sicherheit, Qualität, Kosten und Durchlaufzeit zu identifizieren, mit einem starken Fokus auf Automatisierungs- und Digitalisierungsmöglichkeiten. Konzipieren und implementieren Sie optimierte Produktionsprozesse, Arbeitsplatzkonzepte, Automatisierungslösungen, Geräteauslastungskonzepte und einen verbesserten Materialfluss für die GCB-Montage und -Prüfung. Durchführung von Zeit- und Bewegungsstudien, Prozessabbildung, Wertstromanalyse, Layoutplanung, Kapazitätsanalyse und Engpassbewertungen, um nicht wertschöpfende Aktivitäten zu eliminieren und die Betriebsleistung zu erhöhen. Entwickeln, standardisieren und verbessern Sie Arbeitsanweisungen, Standardbetriebsverfahren, Fertigungsdokumentation und digitale Shopfloor-Prozesse für GCB-Montage-, Test- und Logistikvorgänge. Bewerten, spezifizieren und implementieren Sie neue Fertigungstechnologien wie automatisierte Handhabungssysteme, intelligente Werkzeuge, digitale Arbeitsanweisungen, MES-bezogene Lösungen und datengesteuerte Verbesserungsanwendungen. Unterstützen Sie Industrialisierungsaktivitäten, die Implementierung neuer Produkte, Serien-Ramp-ups, CAPEX-Initiativen, die Beschaffung von Ausrüstung, PFMEA-Aktivitäten und die Einführung neuer Werkzeuge, Vorrichtungen und Prüfgeräte. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktions-, Test-, Engineering-, Industrialisierungs-, Qualitäts-, Lieferketten-, Planungs-, HSE-, Projektmanagement- und Produktmanagementteams, um robuste und nachhaltige Prozessverbesserungen zu gewährleisten. Führen und beteiligen Sie sich an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen, Lean Manufacturing-Projekten, Kaizen-Aktivitäten, Six Sigma-bezogenen Verbesserungen, Shopfloor-Optimierung und digitalen Fabrikinitiativen. Pflegen und verbessern Sie Fertigungsstammdaten, Produktionsstandards, Routinginformationen und KPI-basierte Leistungstransparenz, um eine effiziente Planung und Ausführung zu unterstützen. Tragen Sie zur langfristigen Entwicklung der GCB-Fabrik bei, indem Sie zukünftige Automatisierungspotenziale identifizieren, die Ergonomie verbessern, die Sicherheit erhöhen und skalierbare Produktionskapazitäten ermöglichen. Ihr Hintergrund-Master-Abschluss in Automation Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich. P rofessional Erfahrung in der Industrietechnik, Produktionstechnik, Automatisierung, Industrialisierung oder Herstellungsprozessverbesserung wird bevorzugt. Starkes Verständnis für Prozessoptimierung, Lean Manufacturing, kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmethoden, Kaizen, Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping, Zeitstudien und statistische Prozesskontrolle. Erfahrung in komplexen Montageumgebungen, Hochvoltprodukten, Herstellung von Elektrogeräten, Engineering-to-Order-Produktion oder High-Variety / Low-Volume-Fertigung ist sehr wünschenswert. Gute Kenntnisse der Arbeitsplatzgestaltung, Layoutplanung, Werkzeugkonzepte, Ergonomie, Gerätespezifikation, Fertigungsdokumentation und strukturierte Problemlösung. Die Vertrautheit mit SAP, MES, digitalen Arbeitsanweisungen, Datenanalysetools oder Produktions-KPI-Dashboards ist von Vorteil. stark
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous recherchons un ingénieur industriel hautement motivé dans notre production avec un accent particulier sur la production de Lean et l'optimisation du flux de process pour développer davantage notre environnement de production de circuits de générateurs (GCB) à Zurich. Dans ce rôle, vous appliquerez des principes d'ingénierie industrielle, d'automatisation et de fabrication numérique pour améliorer la productivité, la sécurité, la qualité, le rapport coût-efficacité et les performances de livraison dans un environnement de fabrication à haute variété, à faible volume et à commande. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'analyse et l'amélioration des concepts complexes d'assemblage, de test, de flux de matériaux et de poste de travail, tout en soutenant le développement continu d'une usine maigre, numérique et prête à l'avenir. Comment vous ferez un impact Analysez les mises en page actuelles de production de GCB, les workflows d'assemblage, les processus de test, les flux de matériaux et les procédures opérationnelles afin d'identifier le potentiel d'amélioration de l'efficacité, de la sécurité, de la qualité, des coûts et des délais, en mettant fortement l'accent sur les possibilités d'automatisation et de numérisation. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des processus de production optimisés, des concepts de poste de travail, des solutions d'automatisation, des concepts d'utilisation de l'équipement et un meilleur flux de matériaux pour l'assemblage et les essais GCB. Effectuer des études de temps et de mouvement, la cartographie des processus, l'analyse des flux de valeur, la planification de la disposition, l'analyse des capacités et les évaluations des goulots d'étranglement afin d'éliminer les activités non à valeur ajoutée et d'accroître le rendement opérationnel. Élaborer, normaliser et améliorer les instructions de travail, les procédures d'exploitation normalisées, la documentation de fabrication et les procédés numériques d'atelier pour l'assemblage, les essais et les opérations logistiques du GCB. Évaluer, spécifier et mettre en œuvre de nouvelles technologies de fabrication telles que les systèmes de traitement automatisé, les outils intelligents, les instructions de travail numériques, les solutions liées au MES et les applications d'amélioration axées sur les données. Appuyer les activités d'industrialisation, la mise en oeuvre de nouveaux produits, les up-ups de série, les initiatives CAPEX, l'acquisition d'équipement, les activités PFMEA, et l'introduction de nouveaux outils, de nouveaux gabarits, de nouveaux accessoires et de nouveaux équipements d'essai. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de production, d'essai, d'ingénierie, d'industrialisation, de qualité, de chaîne d'approvisionnement, de planification, de HSE, de gestion de projet et de gestion des produits pour assurer des améliorations robustes et durables des processus. Diriger et participer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue, des projets Lean Manufacturing, des activités Kaizen, des améliorations liées à Six Sigma, l'optimisation des ateliers et des initiatives d'usines numériques. Maintenir et améliorer les données maîtresses de fabrication, les normes de production, l'information sur le routage et la transparence des performances fondée sur l'ICP afin de soutenir une planification et une exécution efficaces. Contribuer au développement à long terme de l'usine GCB en identifiant le potentiel d'automatisation futur, en améliorant l'ergonomie, en renforçant la sécurité et en permettant des capacités de production évolutives. Votre formation Maîtrise en ingénierie d'automatisation, génie industriel, génie manufacturier, génie mécanique, génie électrique ou un domaine technique connexe. L'expérience professionnelle en ingénierie industrielle, en ingénierie de production, en automatisation, en industrialisation ou en amélioration des procédés de fabrication est privilégiée. Une bonne compréhension de l'optimisation des processus, Lean Manufacturing, les méthodes d'amélioration continue, Kaizen, Six Sigma, la cartographie des flux de valeur, les études de temps et le contrôle statistique des processus. L'expérience dans les environnements d'assemblage complexes, les produits à haute tension, la fabrication d'équipements électriques, la production d'ingénierie à commande, ou la fabrication à haute variabilité / à faible volume est hautement souhaitable. Bonne connaissance de la conception des postes de travail, de la planification de la mise en page, des concepts d'outillage, de l'ergonomie, de la spécification des équipements, de la documentation de fabrication et de la résolution structurée des problèmes. Familiarisation avec SAP, MES, instructions de travail numériques, outils d'analyse de données ou tableaux de bord KPI de production est un avantage. Fort

jobs.description:
The opportunity We are looking for a motivated and curious engineering intern to support our Product Excellence team in the area of surge arresters, metal oxide (MO) varistors, and high-voltage protection products. This internship offers the opportunity to work on real-world engineering challenges related to international standards, product qualification, testing, simulations, and technical documentation. Depending on business priorities and the candidate's interests, the internship project will focus on one or more topics from a portfolio of ongoing development and qualification activities. How you'll make an impact Analyzing and comparing international standards (e.g., IEC, IEEE, CIGRE recommendations) and assessing their impact on product design and testing requirements Supporting product qualification and requalification projects for surge arresters and metal oxide varistors, including simulations related to environmental and electrical performance testing Evaluating testing strategies, including the possibility of harmonizing qualification testing across different standards Assisting with laboratory test planning, execution, and analysis Developing engineering calculation tools and templates to support product design and qualification activities Creating and maintaining technical documentation, reports, and engineering guidelines Analyzing test data and preparing technical conclusions and recommendations Investigating emerging industry requirements and proposed standard revisions Collaborating with product management, engineering, testing laboratories, and standards experts Your background Currently enrolled in an MSc program in Electrical Engineering Experience with Python, Matlab, and Electromagnetic Transients Program (EMTP) Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Collaborative and proactive working style Fluent written and spoken English More about us We are a technology‑driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Internship in Reliability Testing for SiC-based Power Semiconductors 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The energy landscape is rapidly evolving, requiring increasingly complex and reliable power distribution systems. The growing integration of renewable energy sources and converter interfaces introduces new challenges for transmission and distribution operators. Silicon carbide (SiC) power semiconductors have matured significantly and offer superior electrical performance, making them highly attractive for power electronics applications. However, challenges related to the gate stack reliability of SiC MOSFETs must still be addressed to enable their widespread adoption. The Semiconductors Packaging and Reliability Engineering research team seeks an intern to support the development of an innovative test setup for reliability investigations. The setup targets threshold voltage stability of SiC MOSFETs under extensive cycling and accelerated aging conditions. The successful candidate will develop and monitor a real-time system for tracking device aging. Experiments are conducted on a double pulse tester with a half-bridge evaluation board rated at 3.3 kV and 150 A. descriptionByLocale.en:

The growing integration of renewable energy sources and converter interfaces introduces new challenges for transmission and distribution operators. Silicon carbide (SiC) power semiconductors have matured significantly and offer superior electrical performance, making them highly attractive for power electronics applications. However, challenges related to the gate stack reliability of SiC MOSFETs must still be addressed to enable their widespread adoption. The Semiconductors Packaging and Reliability Engineering research team seeks an intern to support the development of an innovative test setup for reliability investigations. The setup targets threshold voltage stability of SiC MOSFETs under extensive cycling and accelerated aging conditions. The successful candidate will develop and monitor a real-time system for tracking device aging. Experiments are conducted on a double pulse tester with a half-bridge evaluation board rated at 3.3 kV and 150 A. The internship duration is six months. descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance Die Energielandschaft entwickelt sich rasant und erfordert immer komplexere und zuverlässigere Energieverteilungssysteme. Die zunehmende Integration von erneuerbaren Energiequellen und Umrichterschnittstellen stellt die Übertragungs- und Verteilungsbetreiber vor neue Herausforderungen. Leistungshalbleiter aus Siliziumkarbid (SiC) sind deutlich ausgereift und bieten überlegene elektrische Leistung, was sie für Anwendungen in der Leistungselektronik sehr attraktiv macht. Allerdings müssen noch Herausforderungen im Zusammenhang mit der Gate-Stack-Zuverlässigkeit von SiC-MOSFETs angegangen werden, um ihre breite Akzeptanz zu ermöglichen. Das Forschungsteam von Semiconductors Packaging and Reliability Engineering sucht einen Praktikanten, der die Entwicklung eines innovativen Testaufbaus für Zuverlässigkeitsuntersuchungen unterstützt. Der Aufbau zielt auf die Schwellenspannungsstabilität von SiC-MOSFETs unter umfangreichen Zyklus- und beschleunigten Alterungsbedingungen ab. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird ein Echtzeit-System zur Nachverfolgung der Gerätealterung entwickeln und überwachen. Experimente werden auf einem Doppelpuls-Tester mit einer Halbbrücken-Auswerteplatine mit 3,3 kV und 150 A durchgeführt. Die Praktikumsdauer beträgt sechs Monate. Wie Sie eine Wirkung durchführen Messkampagnen und Datenanalyse basierend auf den neuesten in der Literatur verfügbaren Modellen schlagen innovative Lösungen vor, um mehr Erkenntnisse aus den experimentellen Tests zu sammeln: Erstellen von Sensor-Array-Prototypen und automatisierter Datenerfassungssoftware Optimieren Sie einen Halbbrücken-Konverter für langfristige dynamische Tests von SiC-MOSFETs Upgrade-Testelektronik und Datenerfassungssoftware, die benötigt wird, um hochpräzise Messungen für längere Testzeit durchzuführen Dokument und kommunizieren Sie die entwickelten Lösungen, um das gewonnene Wissen innerhalb des Forschungsteams, der akademischen Mitarbeiter und der Geschäftseinheit zu verbreiten Ihr Hintergrund verfolgt derzeit einen Master-Abschluss in Elektroniktechnik, Materialtechnik, Physik oder einer verwandten Disziplin (offizielle Einschreibung ist unerlässlich) Vertraut mit der Einrichtung elektrischer Messungen und mit dem Entwurf und Bau von Elektroniksystemen. Frühere Erfahrungen mit Halbleiterphysik und / oder Power-Geräte ist ein starkes Plus Erfahrung mit LabView-Programmierung und Kenntnisse der Programmiersprachen (z. B. Python, C, Matlab) fließend in geschriebenem und gesprochenem Englisch Gute Kommunikation und technische Schreibfähigkeiten Kreativ und in der Lage, autonom zu arbeiten Mehr über uns Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen mit einem starken Fokus auf Innovation, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und nachhaltige Fertigung.

Les semi-conducteurs de puissance au carbure de silicium (SiC) ont beaucoup évolué et offrent des performances électriques supérieures, ce qui les rend très attrayants pour les applications électroniques de puissance. L'expérience antérieure avec la physique des semi-conducteurs et/ou les appareils électriques est une expérience plus forte avec la programmation LabView, et la connaissance des langages de programmation (p. ex. Python, C, Matlab) Fluidité en anglais écrit et parlé Bonnes compétences en communication et en écriture technique Créative et capable de travailler de façon autonome Plus sur nous Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie avec un fort accent sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable.

jobs.title: Prüftechniker/in (Test Technician) 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Als Prüftechniker\/in prüfst und dokumentierst du unsere Produkte vor der Auslieferung an Kunden weltweit. Du führst Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) an unserem Produktionsstandort in Zürich durch, analysierst Fehler und stellst sicher, dass unsere Generatorleistungsschalter höchste Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsanforderungen erfüllen.   Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung von Routineprüfungen und Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) mit internationalen Kunden Bewertung und Dokumentation von Prüfergebnissen Erkennen und Beheben von mechanischen und elektrischen Fehlern Weiterentwicklung von Prüfequipment, Messmitteln und Prüfprozessen   Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene elektrotechnische Grundausbildung (z. B. Automatiker EFZ, Elektroinstallateur EFZ); Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF (z. B. descriptionByLocale.it: Attraverso la posizione del tecnico di prova si controlla e documenta i nostri prodotti prima della consegna ai clienti in tutto il mondo. Effettuare i test di accettazione della fabbrica (FAT) presso il nostro sito di produzione a Zurigo, analizzare gli errori e garantire che i nostri interruttori di circuito generatore soddisfino i più elevati requisiti di qualità e sicurezza. Questo può essere ottenuto effettuando test di routine e test di accettazione di fabbrica (FAT) con i clienti internazionali Valutazione e documentazione dei risultati dei test Riconoscimento e fissaggio di errori meccanici ed elettrici Questo è ciò che si porta con completa formazione elettrotecnica di base (ad esempio ingegnere automatico EFZ, installatore elettrico EFZ); Ulteriori formazione a livello di RF (ad esempio ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria del sistema, meccatronica) di vantaggio Esperienza nella lettura e comprensione di schemi elettrici Molto buona conoscenza di tedesco e inglese (min. B2) Alta consapevolezza e professionale che si occupano con i clienti Più su di noi Come il mondo di produzione di generatori Hita Questo è il motivo per cui investiamo specificamente nella nostra infrastruttura, tecnologia di test e dipendenti nei prossimi anni. Vi aspettano sfide tecniche entusiasmanti, contatti internazionali con i clienti e l'opportunità di plasmare attivamente un ambiente in crescita e in futuro.
descriptionByLocale.en: Through the position of test technician you check and document our products before delivery to customers worldwide. You perform Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) at our production site in Zurich, analyze errors and ensure that our generator circuit breakers meet the highest quality and safety requirements. This can be achieved by carrying out routine tests and factory acceptance tests (FAT) with international customers Evaluation and documentation of test results Recognizing and fixing mechanical and electrical errors Further development of test equipment, measuring instruments and test processes This is what you bring with completed basic electrotechnical training (e.g. automatic engineer EFZ, electrical installer EFZ); Further education at the level of RF (e.g. electrical engineering, system engineering, mechatronics) of advantage Experience in reading and understanding electrical schemes Very good knowledge of German and English (min. B2) High quality awareness as well as professional dealing with customers More about us As the world's only production site for generator circuit breakers at Hitachi Energy, our business is continuously growing. That is why we are investing specifically in our infrastructure, testing technology and employees in the coming years. Exciting technical challenges, international customer contacts and the opportunity to actively shape a growing and future-proof environment await you.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Grâce à la position de technicien de test, vous vérifiez et documentez nos produits avant la livraison aux clients dans le monde entier. B2) Sensibilisation de haute qualité ainsi que des relations professionnelles avec les clients Plus sur nous Comme le seul site de production de disjoncteurs de générateurs chez Hitachi Energy, notre entreprise est en croissance continue. C'est pourquoi nous investissons spécifiquement dans notre infrastructure, nos technologies d'essai et nos employés dans les années à venir. Des défis techniques passionnants, des contacts avec les clients internationaux et l'occasion de façonner activement un environnement en pleine croissance et à l'avenir vous attendent.

jobs.title: Trade Operations Specialist 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Als Trade Operations Specialist im Service Business von Hitachi Energy übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Sicherstellung der globalen Einhaltung von Aussenhandelsvorschriften. Als Spezialist für nichtpräferenziellen- und präferenziellen Ursprung und den gängigen Freihandelsabkommen agierst als Drehscheibenfunktion zwischen Projektleitung, Lieferant, Kunde und unserer Exportabteilung. Du bist Teil des Teams Standard Operations, das weltweit für die Distribution von Spareparts zu unseren Produkten verantwortlich ist. Du bist stets auf dem neuesten Stand bezüglich der Importanforderungen in den verschiedenen Ländern und trägst damit, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, zur effizienten und regelkonformen Abwicklung internationaler Waren- und Dienstleistungsströme bei. Das kannst du bewirken Fachstelle im Bereich Freihandelsabkommen und Ursprungsregeln Einforderung der Nachweise für die Gewährleistung des Präferenziellen und Nichtpräferenziellen Ursprungs Präferenzkalkulationen gemäss geltender Freihandelsabkommen, Verwaltung von Ursprungsnachweisen und Klassifizierung von Gütern Ermittlung von Ursprung und HS-Code Mitarbeit in der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Leitung entsprechender Initiativen Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene technische \/kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum\/zur Aussenhandelsfachmann\/-Leiter oder Entsprechende Erfahrung in den relevanten Bereichen Mind. 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Freihandelsabkommen und Ursprungsregeln oder herausragendes Potential zur Entwicklung der geforderten Kompetenzen SAP und GTS-Kenntnisse von Vorteil Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse Lösungsorientierte Denkweise und Eigeninitiative Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise Zugänglicher Teamplayer mit Freude daran, gemeinsam hoch gesteckte Ziele zu erreichen Mehr über uns Wir sind überzeugt, dass Spitzenleistungen dort entstehen, wo sich Menschen wertgeschätzt, unterstützt und fair belohnt fühlen. Unsere Benefits schaffen echten Mehrwert für unsere Mitarbeitenden und fördern Engagement, Leistungsbereitschaft und persönliche Entwicklung. Durch unseren Fokus auf Wohlbefinden und nachhaltiges Wachstum schaffen wir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem persönlicher und unternehmerischer Erfolg Hand in Hand gehen.

The opportunity As a Trade Operations Specialist in Hitachi Energy's Service Business, you will play a key role in ensuring global compliance with international trade regulations. As a specialist in preferential and non-preferential origin as well as major free trade agreements (FTAs), you will act as a central interface between project management, suppliers, customers, and our export department. You will be part of the Standard Operations team, which is responsible for the worldwide distribution of spare parts for our products. Staying up to date with import requirements across different countries, you will contribute to the efficient and compliant execution of international goods and service flows in close collaboration with cross-functional teams. How you'll make an impact Serve as the subject matter expert for free trade agreements and rules of origin Obtain and manage documentation required to ensure preferential and non-preferential origin compliance Perform preferential origin calculations in accordance with applicable free trade agreements Manage certificates and proofs of origin and support the classification of goods Determine product origin and assign the appropriate HS (Harmonized System) codes Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and lead relevant projects and process enhancements Your Background Completed technical or commercial vocational training, ideally supplemented by further education in international trade, customs, or foreign trade management, or equivalent professional experience in a related field At least 3 years of experience working with free trade agr

jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer or Technician - Diffusion 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As a Diffusion Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of diffusion equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of diffusion equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of diffusion, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Experience with diffusion systems (e.g. ASM, centrotherm ovens) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (e.g., Surfscan, Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

aspetti commerciali in stretta collaborazione con le parti interessate tecniche, finanziari e giuridiche - Sostenere lo sviluppo delle imprese fornendo consulenza di esperti su argomenti commerciali e contrattuali, sfruttando una forte conoscenza giuridica

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity Join Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Products business and become part of a globally recognized team delivering advanced solutions for power transmission and distribution. In this role, you will support the development and execution of customer-specific projects for Generator Circuit-Breakers used in power generation applications worldwide. Based in Zurich-Oerlikon, you will combine your electrical engineering expertise with your Mandarin Chinese language skills to support customers and business partners in China and contribute to the global energy transition. How you'll make an impact Create customer-specific wiring and electrical schematics based on technical requirements and project specifications Develop and maintain wiring diagrams for new products and product enhancements using EPLAN P8 Revise electrical documentation to reflect customer requirements, control system changes, and product developments Provide technical support to suppliers involved in control cabinet manufacturing and assembly Maintain and further develop component and language databases within EPLAN P8 Collaborate closely with project managers, engineering teams, suppliers, and international customers Support project execution through occasional travel to customer sites and power plants, mainly in China Ensure compliance with internal procedures, industry standards, safety regulations, and quality requirements Your background Completed apprenticeship, technical diploma, or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in electrical design, engineering, or a comparable technical role Experience with EPLAN P8 or similar ECAD software is an advantage Fluent in Mandarin and English; German language skills are an advantage Strong attention to detail and a structured, precise way of working Independent, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset Team player with strong communication and collaboration skills Willingness to travel internationally as required by projects, approximately 20% More about us Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Products business is a global leader in power transmission and distribution technologies. Within this business, our Generator Circuit-Breaker team develops, manufactures, markets, and services high-current switching systems for power plants around the world. 
• We offer an inclusive and collaborative work environment, flexible working models, and exciting opportunities for professional growth. Join us and help shape a more sustainable energy future for generations to come.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Treten Sie dem Geschäft mit Hochspannungsprodukten von Hitachi Energy bei und werden Sie Teil eines weltweit anerkannten Teams, das fortschrittliche Lösungen für die Energieübertragung und -verteilung bereitstellt. In dieser Funktion unterstützen Sie die Entwicklung und Durchführung kundenspezifischer Projekte für Generator-Schaltungsbrecher, die weltweit in Stromerzeugungsanwendungen eingesetzt werden. Mit Sitz in Zürich-Oerlikon verbinden Sie Ihre Elektrotechnik-Expertise mit Ihren Mandarin-Chinesisch-Sprachkenntnissen, um Kunden und Geschäftspartner in China zu unterstützen und zur globalen Energiewende beizutragen. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Erstellen Sie kundenspezifische Verdrahtung und elektrische Schaltpläne basierend auf technischen Anforderungen und Projektspezifikationen Entwickeln und pflegen Sie Verdrahtungsdiagramme für neue Produkte und Produktverbesserungen mit EPLAN P8 Überarbeiten Sie die elektrische Dokumentation, um Kundenanforderungen, Steuerungssystemänderungen und Produktentwicklungen widerzuspiegeln Bieten Sie technische Unterstützung für Lieferanten, die an der Herstellung und Montage von Schaltschranken beteiligt sind Pflegen und entwickeln Sie Komponenten- und Sprachdatenbanken innerhalb von EPLAN P8 Eng zusammenarbeiten Sie mit Projektmanagern, Ingenieurteams, Lieferanten und internationalen Kunden Unterstützung der Projektdurchführung durch gelegentliche Reisen zu Kundenstandorten und Kraftwerken, vor allem in China Sicherstellen Sie die Einhaltung interner Verfahren, Industriestandards, Sicherheitsvorschriften und Qualitätsanforderungen Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossene Ausbildung, technisches Diplom oder Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Elektrodesign, Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare technische Rolle Erfahrung mit EPLAN P8 oder ähnliche ECAD-Software ist ein Vorteil Fluent in Mandarin und Englisch; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Vorteil Starke Liebe zum Detail und eine strukturierte, präzise Art und Weise der Arbeit Unabhängige, proaktive und lösungsorientierte Denkweise Teamplayer mit starken Kommunikations- und Kollaborationsfähigkeiten Bereitschaft, international zu reisen, wie von Projekten erforderlich, ca. 20% Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy Hochspannungsprodukte Geschäft ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Energieübertragungs- und Verteilungstechnologien. In diesem Geschäft entwickelt, produziert, vermarktet und betreut unser Generator Circuit-Breaker-Team Hochstromschaltsysteme für Kraftwerke auf der ganzen Welt.
• Wir bieten ein integratives und kollaboratives Arbeitsumfeld, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und spannende Möglichkeiten für berufliches Wachstum. Begleiten Sie uns und gestalten Sie eine nachhaltigere Energiezukunft für kommende Generationen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'occasion de rejoindre Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Products et de faire partie d'une équipe mondialement reconnue offrant des solutions avancées pour la transmission et la distribution d'électricité. Dans ce rôle, vous soutiendrez le développement et l'exécution de projets spécifiques à la clientèle pour les générateurs de circuits utilisés dans les applications de production d'électricité dans le monde entier. Basé à Zurich-Oerlikon, vous combinerez votre expertise en génie électrique avec vos compétences en mandarin chinois pour soutenir les clients et les partenaires commerciaux en Chine et contribuer à la transition énergétique mondiale. Comment vous ferez un impact Créer des schémas de câblage et d'électricité spécifiques au client en fonction des exigences techniques et des spécifications du projet Élaborer et entretenir des diagrammes de câblage pour les nouveaux produits et les améliorations du produit en utilisant EPLAN P8 Réviser la documentation électrique pour tenir compte des exigences du client, des changements de système de contrôle et de l'évolution du produit Fournir un soutien technique aux fournisseurs qui participent à la fabrication et à l'assemblage des armoires de contrôle Maintenir et développer davantage les bases de données sur les composants et les langues au sein d'EPLAN P8 Collaborer étroitement avec les gestionnaires de projets, les équipes d'ingénierie, les fournisseurs et les clients internationaux Soutenir l'exécution de projets par des voyages occasionnels vers des sites clients et des centrales électriques, principalement en Chine Assurer le respect des procédures internes, des normes industrielles, des règlements de sécurité et des exigences de qualité Votre formation Apprentissage, diplôme technique ou baccalauréat en génie électrique, en ingénierie d'automatisation ou dans un domaine connexe Minimum de 2 ans d'expérience professionnelle en conception électrique, en ingénierie ou dans un rôle technique comparable L'expérience d'EPLAN P8 ou d'un logiciel ECAD similaire est un avantage Fluent en mandarin et en anglais; les compétences en langue allemande sont un avantage Une grande attention aux détails et une façon structurée et précise de travailler Un état d'esprit indépendant, proactif et axé sur la solution Joueur d'équipe possédant de solides compétences en communication et en collaboration Volonté de voyager à l'étranger comme l'exigent les projets, environ 20% En savoir plus sur nous Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products business est un leader mondial dans les technologies de transmission et de distribution d'électricité. Au sein de cette entreprise, notre équipe de générateurs de circuits-bréakers développe, fabrique, commercialise et fournit des systèmes de commutation à courant élevé pour les centrales électriques du monde entier.
• Nous offrons un environnement de travail inclusif et collaboratif, des modèles de travail flexibles et des possibilités passionnantes de croissance professionnelle. Rejoignez-nous et contribuez à façonner un avenir énergétique plus durable pour les générations à venir.

jobs.description: The Opportunity We, Hitachi Energy – Insulation and Components, are looking for you who would like to join us in the position Sales Engineering Manager! We are working within the transformer business, supplying world-class components to transformer manufacturers worldwide. We are proud of our product portfolio, our global customer base as well as our modern production units. Our strong ambition will always be to be our customers' preferred choice of supply and hope that you will play a key role. Are you a person with excellent leadership skills combined with strong technical expertise and a true interest in working close to customers and colleagues? Do you enjoy leveraging your team's expertise to support colleagues and customers and ensure that our solutions meet customer needs? Then this could be the right opportunity for you! This is a newly created role, offering a unique opportunity to shape and develop the future Sales Engineering organization. As Sales Engineering Manager, you will have a significant impact on how the team operates, collaborates with stakeholders, and supports our colleagues and customers globally. You will lead a regional team of Sales Engineers supporting both Bushings and OLTC. This position is with placement in Ludvika, Sweden or Zurich, Switzerland. How you'll make an impact Lead, inspire and develop a regional team of Sales Engineers while maintaining active engagement with customers and key stakeholders Apply the Sales Engineering team's application expertise in Bushings and Tap-Changers to work closely with customers, sales, marketing and tendering teams, ensuring that our solutions meet customer needs. Foster a highly collaborative environment with both internal and external stakeholders. Actively participate in customer meetings, technical support activities, and sales engineering initiatives, including international travel. Living our core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business   Your background A minimum of three years' engineering experience in Transformer\/Bushings\/OLTC technology. Previous people-management experience within a technical or commercial environment. Communicative and can explain advanced technical knowledge in a simple and easy way. Strategic with a constant business mind, proven commercial experience in complex environments. Fluency (written and spoken) in English is mandatory. Additional language skills such as Swedish, Spanish, German, or French are considered an advantage. International travel required (approx. 20%) More about us Are you ready for an exciting new challenge? Does the above description sound like you? Don't Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don't delay – apply today! More information: Recruiting Manager, Henrik Boström, henrik.bostrom@hitachienergy.com will answer your questions about the position. descriptionByLocale.it: L'Opportunity We, Hitachi Energy – Isolamento e componenti, sono alla ricerca di voi che desiderano unirsi a noi nella posizione Sales Engineering Manager! Stiamo lavorando all'interno del business del trasformatore, fornendo componenti di livello mondiale per produttori di trasformatori in tutto il mondo. Siamo orgogliosi del nostro portafoglio prodotti, della nostra base clienti globale e delle nostre moderne unità produttive. La nostra forte ambizione sarà sempre di essere la scelta preferita dei nostri clienti di approvvigionamento e spero che si svolgerà un ruolo chiave. Sei una persona con eccellenti capacità di leadership combinata con una forte competenza tecnica e un vero interesse a lavorare vicino a clienti e colleghi? Ti piace sfruttare le competenze del tuo team per supportare colleghi e clienti e garantire che le nostre soluzioni soddisfino le esigenze dei clienti? Allora questa potrebbe essere l'occasione giusta per voi! Questo è un ruolo appena creato, offrendo un'opportunità unica per modellare e sviluppare la futura organizzazione Sales Engineering. Come Sales Engineering Manager, avrete un impatto significativo su come il team opera, collabora con gli stakeholder e supporta i nostri colleghi e clienti a livello globale. Potrai guidare un team regionale di ingegneri di vendita che supporta sia Bushings che OLTC. Questa posizione è con collocamento in Ludvika, Svezia o Zurigo, Svizzera. Come farete un impatto Piombo, ispirare e sviluppare un team regionale di ingegneri di vendita, mantenendo attivo il coinvolgimento con i clienti e le principali parti interessate Applicare l'esperienza di applicazione del team di Sales Engineering in Bushings e Tap-Changers per lavorare a stretto contatto con i clienti, le vendite, il marketing e i team di offerta, assicurando che le nostre soluzioni soddisfino le esigenze dei clienti. Promuovere un ambiente altamente collaborativo con parti interessate interne ed esterne. Partecipa attivamente alle riunioni dei clienti, alle attività di supporto tecnico e alle iniziative di ingegneria delle vendite, compresi i viaggi internazionali. Vivere i nostri valori fondamentali di sicurezza e integrità, il che significa assumersi la responsabilità per le proprie azioni mentre si prende cura dei vostri colleghi e del business La vostra esperienza ingegneristica minima di tre anni nella tecnologia Transformer\/Bushings\/OLTC. Precedente esperienza di gestione delle persone all'interno di un ambiente tecnico o commerciale. Comunicante e può spiegare conoscenze tecniche avanzate in modo semplice e semplice. Strategico con una mente aziendale costante, comprovata esperienza commerciale in ambienti complessi. La fluenza (scritta e parlata) in inglese è obbligatoria. Ulteriori competenze linguistiche come svedese, spagnolo, tedesco o francese sono considerate un vantaggio. descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Wir, Hitachi Energy – Isolierung und Komponenten, suchen Sie, die sich uns in der Position Sales Engineering Manager anschließen möchten! Wir arbeiten im Transformatorengeschäft und liefern weltweit erstklassige Komponenten an Transformatorenhersteller. Wir sind stolz auf unser Produktportfolio, unseren globalen Kundenstamm sowie unsere modernen Produktionseinheiten. Unser starker Ehrgeiz wird es immer sein, die bevorzugte Wahl unserer Kunden zu sein und hoffen, dass Sie eine Schlüsselrolle spielen werden. Sind Sie eine Person mit hervorragenden Führungsqualitäten kombiniert mit starkem technischem Know-how und einem echten Interesse an der Nähe von Kunden und Kollegen? Nutzen Sie gerne die Expertise Ihres Teams, um Kollegen und Kunden zu unterstützen und sicherzustellen, dass unsere Lösungen den Kundenbedürfnissen entsprechen? Dann könnte dies die richtige Gelegenheit für Sie sein! Dies ist eine neu geschaffene Rolle, die eine einzigartige Gelegenheit bietet, die zukünftige Sales Engineering Organisation zu gestalten und zu entwickeln. Als Sales Engineering Manager haben Sie einen erheblichen Einfluss darauf, wie das Team arbeitet, mit Stakeholdern zusammenarbeitet und unsere Kollegen und Kunden weltweit unterstützt. Sie werden ein regionales Team von Sales Engineers leiten, das sowohl Bushings als auch OLTC unterstützt. Diese Position ist mit Platzierung in Ludvika, Schweden oder Zürich, Schweiz. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Führen, inspirieren und entwickeln Sie ein regionales Team von Vertriebsingenieuren, während Sie aktiv mit Kunden und wichtigen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten Anwendung der Anwendungskompetenz des Sales Engineering-Teams in Bushings und Tap-Changers, um eng mit Kunden, Vertrieb, Marketing und Ausschreibungsteams zusammenzuarbeiten und sicherzustellen, dass unsere Lösungen die Kundenbedürfnisse erfüllen. Förderung eines hochgradig kooperativen Umfelds mit internen und externen Stakeholdern. Beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an Kundenbesprechungen, technischen Support-Aktivitäten und Sales Engineering-Initiativen, einschließlich internationaler Reisen. Unsere Grundwerte Sicherheit und Integrität leben, was bedeutet, Verantwortung für Ihr eigenes Handeln zu übernehmen und sich um Ihre Kollegen und das Unternehmen zu kümmern Ihr Hintergrund Ein Minimum von drei Jahren Ingenieurerfahrung in der Transformer / Bushings / OLTC-Technologie. Frühere Erfahrung im Personalmanagement in einem technischen oder kommerziellen Umfeld. Kommunikativ und kann fortgeschrittenes technisches Wissen auf einfache und einfache Weise erklären. Strategisch mit einem konstanten Geschäftsgeist, nachgewiesene kommerzielle Erfahrung in komplexen Umgebungen. Fließend (geschrieben und gesprochen) in Englisch ist obligatorisch. Zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse wie Schwedisch, Spanisch, Deutsch oder Französisch gelten als Vorteil. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'Opportunity We, Hitachi Energy – Isolation et Composants, sont à la recherche de vous qui souhaitez vous joindre à nous dans le poste de responsable technique des ventes! Nous travaillons dans le secteur des transformateurs, fournissant des composants de classe mondiale aux fabricants de transformateurs dans le monde entier. Nous sommes fiers de notre portefeuille de produits, de notre clientèle mondiale ainsi que de nos unités de production modernes. Notre ambition forte sera toujours d'être le choix préféré de nos clients et d'espérer que vous jouerez un rôle clé. Êtes-vous une personne avec d'excellentes compétences en leadership combinée avec une solide expertise technique et un véritable intérêt pour travailler à proximité des clients et des collègues? Profitez-vous de l'expertise de votre équipe pour soutenir vos collègues et vos clients et vous assurer que nos solutions répondent aux besoins des clients? Alors ce pourrait être la bonne opportunité pour vous! Il s'agit d'un nouveau rôle, offrant une occasion unique de façonner et de développer la future organisation Sales Engineering. En tant que responsable de l'ingénierie des ventes, vous aurez un impact significatif sur la façon dont l'équipe fonctionne, collabore avec les intervenants et accompagne nos collègues et clients dans le monde entier. Vous dirigerez une équipe régionale d'ingénieurs de vente soutenant à la fois Bushings et OLTC. Ce poste est avec placement à Ludvika, Suède ou Zurich, Suisse. Comment vous ferez un impact Dirigez, inspirez et développez une équipe régionale d'ingénieurs de vente tout en maintenant un engagement actif auprès des clients et des principaux intervenants Appliquez l'expertise de l'équipe d'ingénierie de vente dans Bushings et Tap-Changers pour travailler en étroite collaboration avec les clients, les équipes de vente, de marketing et d'appel d'offres, en veillant à ce que nos solutions répondent aux besoins des clients. Favoriser un environnement de collaboration étroite avec les intervenants internes et externes. Participer activement aux réunions des clients, aux activités de soutien technique et aux initiatives d'ingénierie des ventes, y compris les voyages internationaux. Vivre nos valeurs fondamentales de sécurité et d'intégrité, c'est-à-dire prendre en charge vos propres actions tout en prenant soin de vos collègues et de l'entreprise.Votre expérience d'ingénierie d'au moins trois ans en technologie Transformer\/Bushings\/OLTC. Expérience antérieure en gestion des personnes dans un environnement technique ou commercial. Communiquer et expliquer les connaissances techniques avancées de manière simple et facile. Stratégiquement avec un esprit d'entreprise constant, expérience commerciale prouvée dans des environnements complexes. La fluidité (écrite et parlée) en anglais est obligatoire. Les compétences linguistiques supplémentaires telles que le suédois, l'espagnol, l'allemand ou le français sont considérées comme un avantage. Voyages internationaux requis (environ 20%) Plus sur nous Êtes-vous prêt pour un nouveau défi passionnant? La description ci-dessus vous ressemble-t-elle ? Les demandes ne seront pas examinées de façon continue, alors ne retardez pas – faites votre demande aujourd'hui! descriptionByLocale.it: In qualità di tecnico di manutenzione e manutenzione, assicura l'elevata disponibilità, affidabilità e affidabilità operativa dei nostri impianti di produzione, sistemi di automazione e infrastrutture tecniche presso il sito Wettingen. Supporti la produzione attraverso la risoluzione dei problemi professionali, la manutenzione preventiva e le ottimizzazioni tecniche. In questo modo, si lavora a stretto contatto con diverse aree specializzate e contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo continuo dei nostri impianti e rendere i nostri processi produttivi più efficienti e affidabili. E' possibile raggiungere questo obiettivo assicurando un funzionamento affidabile dei nostri impianti di produzione, sistemi di automazione e infrastrutture tecniche, nonché l'implementazione di ispezioni e valutazioni delle condizioni di impianto Analisi e correzione di guasti tecnici meccanici, elettrici, pneumatici e di automazione, tra cui l'analisi delle cause e l'implementazione sostenibile di misure correttive Attuazione di manutenzione preventiva e di ispezione secondo i piani di manutenzione, nonché il miglioramento continuo degli standard di manutenzione e processi di manutenzione Questo ti porta a una formazione professionale tecnica completa come ingegnere automatista, meccatronico, polimeccanico, elettromeccanico o un'esperienza di formazione tecnica comparabile nel mantenimento di impianti di produzione industriale, nonché la conoscenza in meccanica, pneumatica, ingegneria elettrica e automazione Problemi di conoscenza nei controlli PLC, robotica e sistemi di automazione industriale di vantaggio Esperienza con SAP, sistemi di gestione della manutenzione o strumenti comparabili, nonché la comprensione del TPM, il funzionamento analitico e metodi di eccellenza Con noi, ci si può aspettare un ambiente di lavoro moderno, un team forte e l'opportunità di partecipare attivamente a soluzioni orientate al futuro.
descriptionByLocale.en: As a maintenance and maintenance technician, you ensure the high availability, reliability and operational reliability of our production facilities, automation systems and technical infrastructures at the Wettingen site. You support production through professional troubleshooting, preventive maintenance and technical optimizations. In doing so, you work closely with different specialist areas and actively contribute to the continuous development of our plants and to make our production processes more efficient and reliable. You can achieve this by ensuring reliable operation of our production facilities, automation systems and technical infrastructure as well as implementation of plant inspections and condition assessments Analysis and correction of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic and automation technical faults including cause analysis and sustainable implementation of corrective measures Implementation of preventive maintenance and inspection work according to maintenance plans as well as continuous improvement of maintenance standards and maintenance processes Support production in case of technical problems as well as ensuring compliance with technical standards, quality requirements and safety specifications Identification and implementation of technical improvements to increase plant availability, productivity and quality as well as cooperation in lean, TPM and operational excellence initiatives Support in plant optimizations, conversions, modernizations and technical investment projects Cooperation in the management of critical spare parts as well as ensuring the technical availability of necessary components Documentation of faults, maintenance work and improvement measures in the maintenance system as well as compliance with safety and compliance specifications This brings you with completed technical vocational training as an automatist, mechatronics engineer, polymechanic, electromechanic or a comparable technical training experience in the maintenance of industrial production plants as well as knowledge in mechanics, pneumatics, electrical engineering and automation Knowledge in PLC controls, robotics and industrial automation systems of advantage Experience with SAP PM, maintenance management systems or comparable tools as well as understanding of TPM, lean and operational excellence methods Structured, analytical and solution-oriented working method with high problem-solving competence and a strong safety awareness team ability, service orientation as well as willingness to cooperate in shift operation and pikettservice More about us Hitachi Energy shapes the energy future with innovative technologies for a sustainable and reliable energy supply. With us, you can expect a modern working environment, a strong team and the opportunity to actively participate in future-oriented solutions.

jobs.title: Sales & Tender Manager 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity We are looking for an experienced, enthusiastic, and highly motivated self-driven Sales & Tender Manager to strengthen the Global Competence Center Power Conversion Sales team part of Power Grids Grid Integration Business Unit.  At our company, we value diversity and believe in fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds and genders to apply for this exciting opportunity.    In this position you are responsible for sales of the Grid Integration portfolio with focus on Power Conversion (Static Frequency and Power Quality System Applications) Solutions from lead generation to final negotiation, contract signature and handover to the execution team. During the sales pursuits you will be supported by an interdisciplinary tender team, which you in some cases will lead yourself, which will support during technical clarifications and commercial negotiations.   
• We offer an exciting opportunity for a passionate sales\/ tender person in a dynamic environment who also like to work hands on.      
• Your responsibilities Develop strong networks with Customers and Suppliers to gain valuable Market insights and identify future business opportunities Collaborate closely with the Front-End Sales team to transform leads into opportunities that drive our business forward Understand and empathize with Customer requirements and needs during the acquisition phase Shape innovative sales strategies, selecting winning solutions both commercially and technically Lead the sales and tender process, engaging capture teams where necessary, supported by a diverse interdisciplinary team including engineering, project management, legal, commercial, and supply chain management Prepare comprehensive, timely, and technically sound commercial offers Lead negotiations with Customers, addressing both technical and commercial aspects Ensure seamless integration of Supplier offers, risk assessment, mitigation strategies, and tender completeness Successfully transition negotiated projects to the project execution and engineering departments Your background Proven experience in Sales, Marketing, Tendering, Product Management, or a related field Bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant subject Fluency in English and German. Proficiency in other languages would be an advantage Exceptional communication skills, projecting confidence when engaging with Customers at all levels, from technical teams to top management Experience in Power Electronics, MV Frequency Converters, Power Quality applications, or Grid Integration is desirable Familiarity with the Power Generation or Grid Intertie Applications Market is an asset Skilled in collaborating within cross-functional, cross-border teams, while embracing flexible working arrangements Openness to travel approximately 20% of your working time   More about us Join us on this exciting journey as a Sales & Tender Manager and contribute to shaping the future of power electronics solutions. We look forward to receiving applications from a diverse range of candidates who share our commitment to innovation and excellence. Apply today to make your mark!

jobs.title: Forex Exposure & Special Projects Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity Are you ready to make a global impact in Treasury and Corporate Finance? We are looking for an experienced Treasury and Financial Risk Management professional to lead global Forex exposure reporting and support strategic corporate finance initiatives. In this role, you will strengthen global financial risk reporting, governance, and treasury-related processes while supporting funding, capital structure, and strategic transaction activities across a complex international business environment. How you'll make an impact Lead and continuously improve global FX and commodity exposure reporting standards. Harmonize exposure reporting and governance across Treasury, Finance, and Global Business Units. Enhance reporting frameworks in line with company policies and financial risk management standards. Support complex projects involving hedging strategies, multi-currency cash flow planning, and treasury risk management. Drive effective use of S\/4HANA, Treasury Management Systems, and reporting tools to monitor exposures. Ensure strong governance, internal controls, and adherence to treasury best practices. Develop reporting dashboards, KPIs, and training programs for global stakeholders. Contribute to strategic corporate finance initiatives, including funding projects and M&A activities. jobs.title: Research Scientist - Complex Systems Modelling for Reliability (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   At Hitachi Energy Research, we are shaping the energy systems of tomorrow. As the power grid evolves into a complex, digital “system of systems” integrating renewable energy, power electronics, and distributed assets, ensuring long-term reliability and availability becomes a central challenge. We are looking for a Scientist in Reliability Modelling to drive innovation in system-level reliability modelling and lifecycle optimization of power grid components and system, large-scale power grid infrastructures, including emerging application in challenging environments to help development of sustainable energy sources and their integration to the power grid of the future. How you'll make an impact   System-Level Reliability Modelling Innovation:  Drive the translation of innovative ideas advanced methodologies for reliability, availability, maintainability, and safety (RAMS) modelling integrating single-asset physical knowledge into modelling to represent interdependencies, redundancy, and system-of-systems behavior Data-driven and Physics based Decision Support:  Contribute to methodologies such as Reliability-Centered Maintenance and reliability twin concepts for decision-making under uncertainty with far reaching impact on GW level power systems over decades of operation Scientific Leadership  Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities, technologies and products suppliers Scientific Communication & Innovation:  Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports    Your background    PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Reliability Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related field Systems thinker capable of bridging component-level physics and system-level performance. Strong expertise in system-level reliability modelling (RAMS, RBD, FTA, Monte Carlo, stochastic modelling) Experience with complex engineering systems (energy, aerospace, automotive, or similar high-reliability domains). Including knowledge of maintenance strategies and lifecycle optimization for repairable systems Familiarity with power grid technologies (HVDC, substations, converters) is an advantage but not strictly required Proven track record at top scientific conferences and journal publications Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us   At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every individual. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Join us in shaping a more sustainable and reliable energy future.
