You will be part of an international R&D team developing next-generation gas-insulated switchgear technologies for high-voltage applications. The team combines experienced specialists and developing engineers. We are now looking for a senior engineer who can strengthen our technical expertise and take ownership of complex engineering challenges. If you enjoy solving complex technical problems, working in an international environment, and driving technology advancements, this role offers excellent opportunities to develop your expertise and influence future product innovations. How you'll make an impact Deliver R&D activities for high-voltage product development Support the development of innovative eco-gas solutions Lead technical investigations and root cause analyses Drive product improvement and reliability initiatives Plan, support, and evaluate testing and validation activities Collaborate with global laboratories and external suppliers Provide technical support for existing products and applications Share knowledge and contribute to technical excellence across teams Your background Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a related field Minimum five years of industry experience in engineering or R&D S trong technical expertise in electrical engineerin Experience working in an industrial product development environment Proven ability to work with multiple stakeholders Strong communication skills and fluent English More about us You will work closely with engineering teams, research organizations, laboratories, and suppliers across multiple countries. Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. We also offer: Extra days off between Christmas and New Year Subsidized meals at sites with canteens Discounted conditions in our daycare centres Discounts on various products and services Numerous learning, development, and career opportunities within Hitachi Energy

jobs.title: Project Manager Service Grid Automation 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Within Hitachi Energy's Grid Automation business, we are shaping the future of power transmission and distribution. In our automation and communication service department, based in Baden, we deliver advanced solutions with the highest standards of reliability and innovation in the field of substation automation, protection and communication. We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to take ownership of projects and service agreements in a global, matrix organization. You will coordinate cross-functional teams, act as a key interface to local and international customers and drive successful project delivery while contributing to continuous improvement and long-term value creation. How you'll make an impact Lead the end-to-end execution of local and international service projects and agreements from commercial handover to successful closure, ensuring delivery against scope, timeline, quality, and financial targets Act as the primary interface to customers, building trusted relationships and leading high-impact engagements, including technical discussions and service delivery Drive proactive risk and opportunity management, applying a strategic mindset to ensure sustainable project outcomes Maintain full accountability for project and contract performance, including financial steering, resource planning, and forecasting in close alignment with controlling and operations Lead contract execution, including change and claim management, safeguarding both customer satisfaction and business interests Foster cross-functional collaboration and alignment across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, commissioning and technical support teams in a global setup Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and actively shape best practices within the project management function Your background Proven track record (5+ years) managing complex projects and\/or service agreements in an industrial or technology-driven environment, ideally with international exposure Demonstrated ability to lead stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior customer representatives Strong commercial acumen with solid expertise in financial steering, risk management, and contract execution Confident communicator with the ability to influence, negotiate, and present effectively in an international context Experience working in matrix organizations and leading cross-cultural teams Relevant project management certifications (e.g., PMP, IPMA) are an advantage Fluent in German or French; business fluent in English is mandatory More about us   We are a flexible team with flat structures that operates in a dynamic, project‑oriented environment. Our SLAs and service projects span the full spectrum, from simple to highly complex. We value a hands‑on mentality, strong customer orientation, and a genuine willingness to invest in personal learning and growth. Thanks to our flexible working models, we can accommodate both personal and business needs while creating an environment in which all employees are empowered to perform at their best and continue to develop.

jobs.title: Global AI Prompting Engineer PGTR
jobs.description: The opportunity As part of our ongoing digital transformation journey, we are developing ACE, a cutting-edge Generative AI-powered platform designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of our Bid & Proposal Management process within the Transformers Business Unit. We are seeking a Prompt Engineer who will play a pivotal role in this initiative. This individual will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing domain-specific prompts that enable ACE to generate accurate, context-aware, and business-aligned outputs. The role requires a deep understanding of transformer industry, industrial equipment standards as well as basic understanding of prompt engineering best practices and GenAI model behavior, ensuring that ACE delivers high-quality responses tailored to complex business scenarios. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with IT Experts, Subject Matter Experts, Business stakeholders, and Module Owners to break down complex business logic into domain-specific prompts. How you'll make an impact Develop, refine, and maintain prompt libraries for various transformer units\/factories. Implement advanced techniques like prompt chaining, context injection, and few-shot learning for enterprise-grade accuracy. Own prompt lifecycle management including versioning, traceability, and governance. Evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, and bias mitigation. Conduct A\/B testing and maintain performance dashboards for prompt effectiveness. Work closely with Module Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and Business Stakeholders to embed prompts into ACE workflows. Create clear documentation for prompt strategies and maintain best practices aligned with Hitachi Energy's AI Ethics Charter. Stay updated on emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance ACE capabilities. Implement and recommend best practices for prompting across different ACE modules. Your background Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering Experience working in the transformer industry, with international standards and customer documentation. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong linguistic and logical reasoning for crafting precise prompts. Strong understanding of NLP, context management, and token optimization. Ability to experiment and iterate to optimize outputs. Ability to understand business processes and translate them into ACE-specific prompts. Hands-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering techniques. Strong interest in AI enterprise-grade solutions. Willingness to learn Python and experience with AI APIs services. Ability to work in Agile environments and manage multiple stakeholders. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with attention to detail. Empathy for end users and curiosity for experimentation. Commitment to ethical AI practices and continuous learning. Reduction in prompt failure rate and model hallucination. Improvement in accuracy of outputs by modules. Speed and scalability of prompt deployment across ACE modules within the Transformer Business Unit. Compliance with AI governance and security standards. More about us At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our benefits package is designed to help employees thrive both at work and in their personal lives. Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes:​ Competitive salary and incentives​ Well-being and care ​ Paid and unpaid leave​ Flexible work options ​ Benefits that support your financial security​ You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

L'opportunità

Nel nostro percorso di trasformazione digitale, stiamo sviluppando ACE, una piattaforma all'avanguardia Generative AI, progettata per migliorare l'efficienza e l'accuratezza del nostro processo di gestione dei Bid & Projects all'interno della Business Unit Transformers. Stiamo cercando un Prompt Engineer che svolga un ruolo fondamentale in questa iniziativa. Quest'individuo sarà responsabile della progettazione, test e ottimizzazione di suggerimenti specifici per il dominio che consentano ad ACE di generare output precisi, contestuali e allineati alle aziende.

Il ruolo richiede una profonda comprensione dell'industria dei trasformatori, degli standard industriali delle apparecchiature e una comprensione di base delle best practice ingegneristiche e del comportamento dei modelli GenAI, assicurando che ACE fornisca risposte di alta qualità su misura per scenari aziendali complessi. Il candidato ideale collaborerà strettamente con esperti IT, esperti di materia Matter, stakeholder aziendali e proprietari di moduli per scomporre la complessa logica aziendale in suggerimenti specifici per dominio.

Come farete un impatto

- Sviluppare, perfezionare e mantenere le librerie prompt per varie unità/fabbriche di trasformatori. - Implementare tecniche avanzate come la catena rapida, l'iniezione di contesto e l'apprendimento poco sparato per la precisione di grado enterprise. - Gestione del ciclo di vita rapida propria compresa la versione, la tracciabilità e la governance. - Evaluare le risposte LLM per la precisione, la conformità e la mitigazione dei pregiudizi. - Eseguire test A / B e mantenere i dashboard di prestazioni per la pronta efficacia. - Lavorare a stretto contatto con i proprietari dei moduli, esperti di Matter e parti interessate alle imprese per inviare suggerimenti in flussi di lavoro ACE.

- Creare una chiara documentazione per strategie rapide e mantenere le migliori pratiche in linea con la Carta Etica AI di Hitachi Energy. - Resta aggiornato sulle tecnologie, i framework e gli strumenti emergenti per migliorare le capacità ACE. - Implementa e consiglia le migliori pratiche per sollecitare i diversi moduli ACE.

Requisiti

- Laurea in ingegneria elettrica - L'esperienza nel settore dei trasformatori, con norme internazionali e documentazione dei clienti - Il pensiero forte e analitico - Il forte ragionamento linguistico e logico per elaborare le istruzioni precise - La forte comprensione della NLP, la gestione del contesto e l'ottimizzazione del token - La capacità di sperimentare e di ottimizzare le uscite - La capacità di comprendere i processi aziendali e di tradurle in suggerimenti specifici per l'ACE - L'esperienza pratica con LLM e le tecniche di ingegneria rapida - L'interesse per l'AI

soluzioni di livello enterprise - Volontà di imparare Python e esperienza con i servizi API - Capacità di lavorare in ambienti Agile e gestire più stakeholder - Ottime competenze di comunicazione e collaborazione - Mindset analitico con attenzione ai dettagli - Empathy for end users and curiosity for experimental - Impegno alle pratiche etiche AI e apprendimento continuo

Cosa offriamo

- Salario competitivo e incentivi - Benessere e cura - Congedo retribuito e non retribuito - Opzioni di lavoro flessibili - Vantaggi che sostengono la vostra sicurezza finanziaria

Durante il processo di reclutamento riceverete informazioni più specifiche.

Per quanto riguarda la posizione di leader del team/in montaggio elettrico presso la fabbrica di valvole GI di Seon o Turgi, si guida un team di circa 15 dipendenti. descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

About the position as team leader/in electrical assembly at the GI Valves factory in Seon or Turgi you lead a team of about 15 employees. You take on a central role in the daily production control. You coordinate operational activities within the team and ensure that assembly, testing and logistics processes run efficiently, safely and in a quality-oriented manner. jobs.title: Network and Security Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this challenging role, you will design the network and security architecture for communication networks used in power utilities, wind farms, and other critical infrastructure, based on the modern technology standards. How you'll make an impact You will develop systems in compliance with security standards such as IEC 62443 and NERC-CIP You will implement planned cybersecurity measures on devices and applications You will support the sales organization during the tender phase and in customer discussions With your technical expertise, you will assist the project manager and coordinate with both customers and internal stakeholders You will prepare procedures and operational manuals tailored to customer requirements You will conduct risk assessments as part of project execution, in alignment with IEC 62443, to identify and evaluate cybersecurity risks within industrial automation systems and ensure appropriate security measures are implemented Your background You have a degree in power engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, or equivalent professional experience, along with experience in communication networks and system architectures in industrial or infrastructure environments You are proficient in cybersecurity technologies, LAN\/WAN networks, peripheral devices, and operating systems including MS Windows (Server, AD) and Linux You demonstrate strong communication skills, team spirit, and the ability to work independently Excellent command of English is required You are motivated to help build a new business area and actively support the transition to a cybersecure work approach, assisting engineers in adopting cybersecurity best practices More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità In questo ruolo impegnativo, si progetta la rete e l'architettura di sicurezza per le reti di comunicazione utilizzate nelle utenze di potenza, nelle fattorie eoliche e in altre infrastrutture critiche, basate sugli standard tecnologici moderni. Come farete un impatto svilupperete sistemi in conformità agli standard di sicurezza come IEC 62443 e NERC-CIP Attuerai misure di sicurezza informatica pianificate su dispositivi e applicazioni Sosterrete l'organizzazione di vendita durante la fase di gara e nelle discussioni dei clienti Con la vostra competenza tecnica, assisterete il responsabile del progetto e vi coordinate sia con i clienti che con gli stakeholder interni Potrai preparare procedure e manuali operativi su misura per le esigenze del cliente Condurrai le valutazioni dei rischi nell'ambito dell'esecuzione dei progetti, in allineamento con IEC 62443, per identificare e valutare i rischi di sicurezza informatica all'interno dei sistemi di automazione industriale e garantire l'implementazione di adeguate misure di sicurezza Hai una laurea in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria elettrica, tecnologia dell'informazione, o esperienza professionale equivalente, insieme con esperienza nelle reti di comunicazione e architetture di sistema in ambienti industriali o infrastrutturali Sei abile nelle tecnologie di sicurezza informatica, reti LAN\/WAN, dispositivi periferici e sistemi operativi, tra cui MS Windows (Server, AD) e Linux Si dimostra forti capacità di comunicazione, spirito di squadra, e la capacità di lavorare indipendentemente Ottimo comando dell'inglese è richiesto Siete motivati a contribuire a costruire una nuova area di business e sostenere attivamente la transizione a un approccio di lavoro di sicurezza informatica, aiutando gli ingegneri nell'adottare le best practice di sicurezza informatica. I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo – il rifornimento di impegno, le prestazioni e la crescita. Con la priorità del benessere, costruiamo un posto di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme.

Comment vous allez avoir un impact Vous développerez des systèmes conformes aux normes de sécurité telles que IEC 62443 et NERC-CIP Vous mettrez en œuvre les mesures de cybersécurité prévues sur les appareils et les applications Vous accompagnerez l'organisation commerciale pendant la phase d'appel d'offres et lors des discussions avec les clients Avec votre expertise technique, vous assisterez le gestionnaire de projet et vous coordonnerez avec les clients et les intervenants internes. jobs.title: Equipment Engineer -Diffusion, 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity    Join Hitachi, Ltd. as an Equipment Engineer and play a key role in optimizing and maintaining manufacturing equipment to ensure high performance, reliability, and efficiency. You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to continuous improvement and supporting innovative manufacturing processes.  As a Diffusion Maintenance Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the availability, efficiency, and continuous improvement of semiconductor high temperature production systems. This role focuses on the Corrective and Preventive maintenance and optimization of Diffusion & Cleaning equipment while working closely with cross-functional teams to enhance safety, productivity, and system reliability. How you'll make an impact  Develop and implement modifications and upgrades to existing manufacturing equipment to improve efficiency, yield, and safety  Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of complex manufacturing machinery and systems  Analyse equipment performance data to identify trends, predict failures, and implement preventive measures  Collaborate with production, R&D, and quality teams to resolve equipment-related issues and optimize processes  Create and maintain documentation for equipment operation, maintenance procedures, and technical specifications  Train technicians and operators on new equipment and updated procedures  Manage spare parts inventory and ensure timely procurement of required components and ensure compliance with safety standards and environmental regulations  Support the selection, installation, and qualification of new manufacturing equipment  Your background  Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or electrical Engineering  Minimum 2 years of experience in equipment engineering within a manufacturing environment  Experience in the Semiconductor field is highly desirable Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, and control systems  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, and pneumatics; experience with Diffusion Semiconductor systems is a plus (e.g., ASM, Centrotherm furnaces) Proven ability to troubleshoot complex machinery and identify root causes of failures  Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methods  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills  Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment  English is mandatory, German is beneficial   More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Secondary Design Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Secondary Design Engineer to join our GIS engineering team. In this role, you will support the execution of secondary engineering deliverables for high-voltage GIS projects, including Local Control Cabinet (LCC) and digital substation applications. You will contribute to engineering documentation across project phases and help deliver high-quality, standard-compliant results while building your expertise in secondary design engineering and tools such as Zuken E3. How you'll make an impact Prepare schematics and related engineering documents for GIS secondary engineering scopes, including LCC and digital substation applications Support engineering execution across project phases, from base design and detail design through manufacturing documentation and as-built updates Create preliminary BOMs, reports, and manufacturing documents using approved engineering tools and standard processes Perform structured self-checks and contribute to technically correct, high-quality, and standard-compliant deliverables Support technical clarifications with internal stakeholders, project teams, and factories, and help document and close open points Contribute to continuous improvement, standardization, and engineering best practices, including participation in relevant expert communities Apply internal guidelines, engineering standards, and quality requirements while supporting safe and efficient project execution Your background Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline 2–3 years of professional experience in secondary engineering, design engineering, or project engineering is expected Practical experience with engineering tools such as Zuken E3 or comparable ECAD \/ engineering tools is required Basic knowledge of GIS, secondary engineering principles, and applicable standards such as IEC, IEEE, or ANSI is beneficial Structured and reliable way of working, willingness to learn, and ability to collaborate across functions and disciplines Fluency in English is required; German and other languages are an advantage More about us Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader advancing a sustainable energy future for all. You will work in a collaborative and international environment where innovation, learning, and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.

jobs.title: Process Engineer BiMOS Backend - Assembly 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated chip assembly and soldering. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability of chip attach processes through the application of statistical methods and design of experiments Analyse production data to enhance process performance, identify long-term trends, and support the prevention of potential failures Lead the optimization of automated production systems to improve manufacturing capacity, stability, and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis activities to sustain and improve production throughput Contribute to new product development by shaping production processes and supporting the successful transition to volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment Solid machine-vision and automated inspection skills, as well as experience in Pick and Place processes Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Shift Equipment Maintenance Engineer – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!   How you'll make an impact  Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability  Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners  Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance  Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements  Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals  Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems  Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency  Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment  Your background  Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)  2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries  Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems  Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations  Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)  More about us   You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.  Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.  This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti al nostro team innovativo come Ingegnere di Manutenzione Shift e gioca un ruolo fondamentale nel cuore della produzione di semiconduttori! Con una forte attenzione ai processi di incisione, lavorerai con tecnologia all'avanguardia per ottimizzare le prestazioni del sistema e garantire operazioni senza interruzioni. Questa è la tua opportunità di collaborare con gli esperti, contribuire a progetti innovativi e crescere in un ambiente dinamico e high-tech. Se siete appassionati di precisione e innovazione, vogliamo sentirvi! Mantenere e ottimizzare l'attrezzatura chimica e plasmatica bagnata per garantire un'elevata disponibilità di sistemi complessi di riparazione e risoluzione dei problemi in collaborazione con i partner OEM Pianifica e supporta le attività di manutenzione preventiva per migliorare le prestazioni degli strumenti Gestisci i pezzi di ricambio e contribuisci agli aggiornamenti delle attrezzature e ai miglioramenti dei processi Collabora con i team di ingegneria, R&D e operazioni per supportare gli obiettivi di produzione Creare e mantenere la documentazione tecnica e supportare il monitoraggio dei dati nei sistemi MES Identificare e implementare e implementare miglioramenti nel rispetto degli strumenti di conformità ai processi Solida comprensione dell'elettronica, della meccanica, della pneumatica e dei sistemi di vuoto Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente di team-oriented e all'interno delle operazioni a turni Buone capacità di comunicazione in inglese (il tedesco è un plus) Ti unirai a un ambiente di produzione dinamico e veloce in cui il lavoro di squadra, l'affidabilità e l'eccellenza tecnica sono fondamentali. Questo ruolo offre esperienza pratica con tecnologie complesse e l'opportunità di sviluppare le tue competenze tecniche, contribuendo direttamente alla stabilità e alle prestazioni della produzione.

descriptionByLocale.de: Treten Sie unserem innovativen Team als Shift Maintenance Engineer bei und spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle im Herzen der Halbleiterproduktion! Dies ist Ihre Gelegenheit, mit Experten zusammenzuarbeiten, zu bahnbrechenden Projekten beizutragen und in einem dynamischen High-Tech-Umfeld zu wachsen. Wenn Sie sich für Präzision und Innovation begeistern, möchten wir von Ihnen hören! Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Pflegen und optimieren Nasschemie- und Plasmaätzgeräte, um eine hohe Verfügbarkeit zu gewährleisten Fehlersuche und Reparatur komplexer Systeme in Zusammenarbeit mit OEM-Partnern Planen und unterstützen Sie präventive Wartungsaktivitäten zur Verbesserung der Werkzeugleistung Verwalten Sie Ersatzteile und tragen Sie zu Ausrüstungsupgrades und Prozessverbesserungen bei Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, F & E- und Betriebsteams zur Unterstützung der Produktionsziele Erstellen und pflegen Sie technische Dokumentation und unterstützen Sie die Datenverfolgung in MES-Systemen Identifizieren und implementieren Sie Verbesserungen in Werkzeugen, Prozessen und Betriebseffizienz Sicherstellen Sie die Einhaltung von HSE-Standards und fördern Sie eine sichere Arbeitsumgebung Ihre Hintergrund-Technische Berufsausbildung in Automatisierung, Elektronik oder einem verwandten Bereich (EFZ oder gleichwertig) 2+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Gerätewartung in Halbleiter- oder ähnlichen Branchen Starke technische Kenntnisse in Plasmawerkzeugen (z. B. AMAT, LAM-Systeme) Solides Verständnis von Elektronik, Mechanik, Pneumatik und Vakuumsystemen Fähigkeit, in einer teamorientierten Umgebung und im Schichtbetrieb zu arbeiten Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch (Deutsch ist ein Plus) Mehr über uns Sie werden einer dynamischen und schnelllebigen Produktionsumgebung beitreten, in der Teamwork, Zuverlässigkeit und technische Exzellenz der Schlüssel sind. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Rejoignez notre équipe innovante en tant qu'ingénieur de maintenance de quart et jouez un rôle crucial au cœur de la production de semi-conducteurs ! Avec une forte concentration sur les processus de gravure, vous travaillerez avec une technologie de pointe pour optimiser les performances du système et assurer des opérations sans faille. C'est l'occasion de collaborer avec des experts, de contribuer à des projets novateurs et de se développer dans un environnement dynamique et de haute technologie. Si vous êtes passionné par la précision et l'innovation, nous voulons vous entendre! Comment vous ferez un impact Maintenez et optimisez l'équipement de fabrication de produits chimiques et de plasma humide pour assurer une grande disponibilité Systèmes complexes de dépannage et de réparation en collaboration avec les partenaires d'OEM Planifier et soutenir des activités de maintenance préventive pour améliorer la performance des outils Gérer les pièces de rechange et contribuer à la mise à niveau de l'équipement et à l'amélioration des procédés Collaborer avec les équipes d'ingénierie, de R-D et d'exploitation pour appuyer les objectifs de production Créer et maintenir de la documentation technique et soutenir le suivi des données dans les systèmes MES Identifier et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations dans les outils, les processus et l'efficacité opérationnelle Assurer la conformité aux normes HSE et promouvoir un environnement de travail sûr Vos antécédents Formation professionnelle technique en automatisation, en électronique ou dans un domaine connexe (EFZ ou équivalent) 2+ années d'expérience dans l'entretien de l'équipement dans les industries semi-conducteurs ou similaires Forte connaissance technique des outils plasma (p. ex. systèmes AMAT, LAM) Compréhension solide de l'électronique, de la mécanique, des pneumatiques et des systèmes de vide Capacité de travailler en équipe et dans le cadre d'opérations par équipes Bonnes compétences en communication en anglais (l'allemand est un plus) Plus sur nous Vous rejoindrez un environnement de production dynamique et rapide où le travail d'équipe, la fiabilité et l'excellence technique sont essentiels. En travaillant dans une configuration basée sur le décalage, vous ferez partie d'une équipe de maintenance hautement qualifiée soutenant des opérations critiques et des processus de fabrication avancés. Ce rôle offre une expérience pratique avec des technologies complexes et la possibilité de développer vos compétences techniques tout en contribuant directement à la stabilité de la production et aux performances.

jobs.title: Umweltspezialist 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Gestalte aktiv die Zukunft mit – dort, wo Sicherheit und Innovation aufeinandertreffen. Wir suchen eine engagierte und fachkompetente Umweltspezialistin bzw. einen engagierten und fachkompetenten Umweltspezialisten, die\/der unser Bestreben nach einem sicheren, gesunden und nachhaltigen Arbeitsumfeld weiter stärkt. In dieser zentralen Funktion verantwortest du Initiativen zum Schutz unserer Mitarbeitenden, stellst die Einhaltung relevanter Vorschriften sicher und förderst eine proaktive Sicherheits- und Umweltkultur im gesamten Unternehmen. Das kannst du bewirken Sicherstellen der Einhaltung von Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie interner Richtlinien Durchführen von Risiko‑, Gefahren‑ und Umweltanalysen inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Planen und Durchführen von internen Audits, Begehungen und Umweltkontrollen Untersuchen von Unfällen und Ereignissen sowie Erarbeitung von Präventionsmassnahmen Mitarbeit an Nachhaltigkeit‑ und Umweltprojekten sowie Förderung der Umweltkultur Erstellen und Durchführen von Schulungen zu Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsrelevanten Themen Beratung und Unterstützung von Führungskräften und Projektteams bei HSE‑Fragestellungen Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden, Auditoren und externen Partnern Das bringst du mit Abschluss in Umweltwissenschaften, Umwelttechnik, Arbeitssicherheit oder einem vergleichbaren technischen\/naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich (FH\/Universität) Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im HSE oder Umweltbereich, idealerweise in Industrie, Produktion oder technischen Organisationen Fundierte Kenntnisse der Schweizer Arbeitssicherheits- und Umweltgesetzgebung, inklusive relevanter Verordnungen (z. B. Störfallverordnung, Chemikalienrecht, Umweltschutzrecht) Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikoanalysen, Gefahrenermittlungen sowie Unfall und Ereignisabklärungen, inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Praxis in der Planung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Audits, Inspektionen und internen Begehungen, idealerweise gemäss ISO 14001 \/ ISO 45001 Starke Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenzen für die Unterstützung von Führungskräften, Projektleitenden und Mitarbeitenden in HSE-Belangen Fähigkeit zur Erstellung und Durchführung von Schulungen zu Arbeitssicherheit, Umwelt und Nachhaltigkeit, sowie Analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung im Umgang mit HSE-Kennzahlen, Reporting und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Landessprachen von Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, persönliche und berufliche Leistung zu optimieren und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden ihre Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln und wachsen können.

Siamo alla ricerca di uno specialista ambientale impegnato e competente o di uno specialista ambientale dedicato e competente che rafforza ulteriormente il nostro impegno per un ambiente di lavoro sicuro, sano e sostenibile. In questa funzione centrale, sei responsabile di iniziative per proteggere i nostri dipendenti, garantire il rispetto delle normative pertinenti e promuovere una sicurezza proattiva e la cultura ambientale in tutta l'azienda. L'utente può raggiungere questo obiettivo garantendo il rispetto delle normative ambientali e di sicurezza, nonché delle linee guida interne per l'esecuzione di analisi dei rischi, dei rischi e dell'ambiente, compresa la derivazione di misure Pianificazione e realizzazione di audit interni, controlli e controlli ambientali. Con una laurea in scienze ambientali, tecnologia ambientale, sicurezza sul lavoro o un'area di scienze tecniche / naturali comparabili (FH / università) Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel settore HSE o ambientale, idealmente nell'industria, nella produzione o nelle organizzazioni tecniche Conoscenza approfondita della legislazione svizzera in materia di sicurezza sul lavoro e sull'ambiente, compresi i regolamenti pertinenti (per esempio il diritto di incidente e di incidente, la legge sulle sostanze chimiche, la legge sulla tutela dell'ambiente) Esperienza nella realizzazione di analisi dei rischi, determinazione dei rischi e chiarificazione degli incidenti e degli eventi, compresa la derivazione delle misure Pratiche nella pianificazione, implementazione e follow-up di audit, ispezioni e ispezioni interne, idealmente secondo ISO 14001 \ / ISO 45001 Forte capacità di comunicazione e consulenza per sostenere manager, project manager e dipendenti in materia HSE Capacità di creare e svolgere formazione sulla sicurezza, l'ambiente e la sostenibilità, nonché competenze analitiche e l'esperienza in tedesco
descriptionByLocale.en: Through the position, actively shape the future – where security and innovation meet. We are looking for a committed and competent environmental specialist or a dedicated and competent environmental specialist who further strengthens our commitment to a safe, healthy and sustainable working environment. In this central function, you are responsible for initiatives to protect our employees, ensure compliance with relevant regulations and promote a proactive safety and environmental culture throughout the company. You can achieve this by ensuring compliance with environmental and safety regulations as well as internal guidelines Performing risk, hazard and environmental analyses including derivation of measures Planning and carrying out internal audits, inspections and environmental controls Investigating accidents and events as well as development of prevention measures Collaboration in sustainability and environmental projects as well as promotion of environmental culture Establishing and carrying out training on environmental and safety-related topics Advising and supporting managers and project teams on HSE issues Cooperation with authorities, auditors and external partners With a degree in environmental sciences, environmental technology, occupational safety or a comparable technical / natural sciences area (FH / university) Several years of professional experience in the HSE or environmental sector, ideally in industry, production or technical organizations In-depth knowledge of Swiss occupational safety and environmental legislation, including relevant regulations (e.g. accident and incident law, chemicals law, environmental protection law) Experience in carrying out risk analyses, hazard determinations as well as accident and event clarification, including derivation of measures Practice in the planning, implementation and follow-up of audits, inspections and internal inspections, ideally according to ISO 14001 \/ ISO 45001 Strong communication and consulting skills for supporting managers, project managers and employees in HSE matters Ability to create and carry out training on occupational safety, environment and sustainability, as well as analytical skills and experience in dealing with HSE indicators, reporting and continuous improvement Very good knowledge of German as well as good knowledge of English.

jobs.title: Kaufmännischer Projektmanager – Transformatoren 80 – 100 % (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Du möchtest in einem internationalen Team spannende Projekte im Bereich Transformatoren realisieren? Du bringst Erfahrung im kundenorientierten und kostenoptimierten Projektmanagement mit und möchtest aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung eines dynamischen Umfelds beitragen? Bereit, die Zukunft mitzugestalten – idealerweise im süddeutschen Raum? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Das kannst du bewirken Verantwortung für mittlere bis große Projekte im Transformatorengeschäft Steuerung und Überwachung der Projektanforderungen, einschließlich Zeitplänen, Dokumentation, Projektoptimierungen, Kostenkontrolle, Projektzielen und Risikobewertungen Klärung technischer Details mit Kunden und internen Stakeholdern nach Auftragseingang Zentrale Ansprechperson für die interne und externe Projektkommunikation, sowohl gegenüber Kunden als auch dem Produktionsstandort Sicherstellung eines erfolgreichen Projektabschlusses gemäß vertraglichen Bedingungen und internen Richtlinien Verantwortung für Claim- und Reklamationsmanagement zur Minimierung potenzieller Geschäftsrisiken Dein Hintergrund Studium der Elektrotechnik, des Maschinenbaus oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets Mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung im komplexen Projektmanagement, idealerweise mit mehreren parallellaufenden Projekten Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Transformatoren, Kenntnisse in der Hochspannungstechnik sind von Vorteil Erfahrung im Claim- und Risikomanagement Gute Kenntnisse im Vertragsrecht Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Französisch ist von Vorteil Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung (z. B. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) ist ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.   --- English translation below --- Commercial Project Manager – Transformers 80 – 100% (f\/m\/d)   The opportunity Would you like to deliver exciting transformer projects as part of an international team? Do you bring experience in customer-focused and cost-optimized project management and want to actively contribute to the development of a dynamic environment? Ready to help shape the future? Then apply now! How you'll make an impact Responsibility for medium to large projects in the transformer business Management and monitoring of project requirements including schedules, documentation, project optimizations, cost control, project objectives, and risk assessments Clarification of technical details with customers and internal stakeholders following order placement Acting as the central point of contact for internal and external project communication, both with customers and production site Ensuring successful project completion in accordance with contractual conditions and internal guidelines Ownership of claims and complaint management to prevent potential business risks Your background Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field At least 8 years of experience in project management, ideally involving multiple parallel projects In-depth knowledge in transformers, knowledge in High Voltage technology is a plus Experience in claims and risk management Solid understanding of contract law Fluency in German and English, French is a plus Project management certification (e.g. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Vuoi realizzare progetti entusiasmanti nel campo dei trasformatori in un team internazionale? Hai esperienza nella gestione del progetto orientata al cliente e ottimizzata ai costi e vorresti contribuire attivamente all'ulteriore sviluppo di un ambiente dinamico? jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer – Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. Service is the key to success. As a colleague in our globally active service team, you will appreciate the independent, varied and solution-oriented work. After a versatile, practice-oriented training in Switzerland and abroad, you will lead new GIS installations around the globe. A technically challenging position in a multicultural environment awaits you. You can expect an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow in it. Senior as well as junior applications are welcome! How you will make an impact Managing multicultural construction sites worldwide for gas insulated switchgear for the voltage level of 110KV - 550KV. Responsible for the successful execution of on-site installation \/ maintenance \/ repairs in compliance with contractual deadlines and in compliance with local legal requirements. Responsible for the quality of work performed on site through quality control and assessment of skills of local support staff. Conduct on-site product training on the product and during installation (optional). Coordination of local labor. Cost control of resources used and regular reporting to project management. Actively contribute to process improvements and proactively take measures to increase the efficiency of on-site activities. Your background Completed apprenticeship in the metal construction, electrical or automotive industry, or similar Basic knowledge in electrical engineering is a desirable must, further training in electrical engineering is an advantage Work experience in assembly & commissioning is an advantage Very good German and good English skills, at least B2 Willingness for national and especially international worldwide assignments with up to 90 % travel time Flexible, resilient and communicative team player Flair for pragmatic and unconventional solutions with high quality and safety standards More about us Exciting and varied tasks with great creative freedom Attractive training and development opportunities Interesting and very varied activities\/projects, including off-shore assignments Well-established and dynamic team Open corporate culture An attractive benefits package including fixed, travel and meal expenses, as well as a say in the choice of accommodation

descriptionByLocale.it: L'occasione Hitachi Energy, prodotti ad alta tensione, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. L'unità di servizio è responsabile per il mondo dopo il supporto di vendita di sistemi generatore-rompatore (GCB) e commutatori isolati a gas (GIS), tra cui formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi di valore aggiunto, risoluzione dei problemi, estensioni, retrofit e sostituzioni. Il servizio è la chiave del successo. Come collega del nostro team di assistenza globale, apprezzerete il lavoro indipendente, vario e orientato alla soluzione. Dopo una formazione pratica e versatile in Svizzera e all'estero, guiderai nuove installazioni GIS in tutto il mondo. Una posizione tecnicamente impegnativa in un ambiente multiculturale vi aspetta. Si può aspettare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere in esso. Senior così come le applicazioni junior sono benvenuti! Gestione di siti di costruzione multiculturali in tutto il mondo per interruttori isolati a gas per il livello di tensione di 110KV - 550KV. Responsabile per la riuscita dell'esecuzione dell'installazione in loco \/ manutenzione \/ riparazioni in conformità alle scadenze contrattuali e nel rispetto dei requisiti legali locali. Responsabile della qualità del lavoro svolto in loco attraverso il controllo della qualità e la valutazione delle competenze del personale di supporto locale. Condurre la formazione del prodotto in loco sul prodotto e durante l'installazione (opzionale). Coordinamento del lavoro locale. Controllo dei costi delle risorse utilizzate e reporting regolare alla gestione del progetto. Contribuire attivamente ai miglioramenti del processo e adottare proattivamente misure per aumentare l'efficienza delle attività in loco. Il tuo background Apprendistato completo nella costruzione di metalli, nell'industria elettrica o nel settore automobilistico, o simili La conoscenza di base nell'ingegneria elettrica è un must desiderabile, ulteriore formazione nell'ingegneria elettrica è un vantaggio L'esperienza di lavoro nell'assemblaggio e nella messa in servizio è un vantaggio Molto buono tedesco e buone abilità inglesi, almeno B2 Volontà per compiti nazionali e soprattutto internazionali in tutto il mondo con un tempo di viaggio flessibile, resiliente e comunicativo Un pacchetto di benefici interessanti che comprende spese fisse, di viaggio e di pasto, così come una voce nella scelta di alloggio

jobs.title: Teamleader Design Engineering - Generator Circuit Breaker 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join our Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) team and contribute to products that shape the reliability and performance of power generation worldwide. In this role, you will lead and support a motivated team of CAD Designers while collaborating closely with experienced engineers, project leads suppliers, and the in Oerlikon located factory across the entire product lifecycle—from early design concepts to continuous improvement initiatives. You will have the chance to make a real impact by driving high quality design practices, fostering unified working methods, and championing process and documentation excellence. Through a structured introduction program, you will gain the independence and confidence needed to steer your team effectively, while benefiting from targeted training and development opportunities that support your professional growth. How you'll make an impact Coach and lead a team of CAD Designers, ensuring high quality creation, modification, and maintenance of engineering data for generator circuit-breaker systems and components (team size approx. 10 FTE) Develop\/enhance\/maintain master data of all GCB products with 3D-models, drawings and bill of materials in CAD\/PLM systems  Implement special designs, cost-saving projects and drive product quality improvements Initiate and establish design-process improvements Ensure efficient collaboration with other engineering functions, project leads and further stakeholders Contribute to apprentice supervision and training together with the apprentice advisors of the team As People Manager, you will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines Your background Solid technical foundation as senior designer or equivalent engineering background Proven experience and confident handling of CAD tools (preferably Creo) Strong working knowledge of PLM systems (preferably PTC Windchill), roles, object management, and release processes Experience in a team leading function or as a project manager of a project team Distinct self-organization skills, as well as precise, independent working style Ability to structure work, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple design topics simultaneously with high quality and reliability Mindset oriented toward process improvement, document quality, and establishing structured working methods Fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
